ae.discond/discond.description: Get one Discond merchant by id: name, a short description when we have one, categories, providers, link and its branches. Pass the user's lat/lng when known so branches come nearest first, with distance. When the user is signed in to Discond, its top live offers are included.

business_id.description: Merchant id from discond_find_discounts or discond_autocomplete_businesses.

include_offers.description: Include live offers (signed-in users only). Default: true when signed in.

lat.description: User's latitude (with lng). Branches are then sorted nearest first.

ae.discond/discond.name: discond_list_offers
ae.discond/discond.description: List live Discond offers, filtered by merchant, branch, provider, category, validity or online-only, sorted by newest, expiring or biggest discount. Has no place filter: filter by merchant id instead. Requires the user to be signed in to Discond.

q.description: Words in the offer or merchant name.

business_id.description: Only offers of this merchant (id from discond_find_discounts).

business_branch_id.description: Only offers valid at this branch of the merchant.

include_all_branches.description: With business_branch_id: also include offers valid at all of the merchant's branches.

sort.description: discount: biggest first (default). newest: most recently added. expiring: ending soonest.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response meta.next_cursor

ae.discond/discond.name: discond_get_offer
ae.discond/discond.description: Get one Discond offer by id: headline, terms, validity and redeem links. Requires the user to be signed in to Discond.

offer_id.description: Offer id from discond_list_offers, discond_get_business or discond_find_discounts.

ae.discond/discond.name: discond_list_categories
ae.discond/discond.description: List Discond merchant categories with ids, optionally filtered by name.

q.description: Part of the name to filter by.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for the next page.

ae.discond/discond.name: discond_list_providers
ae.discond/discond.description: List the discount providers Discond covers (for example Fazaa, The Entertainer, Talabat) with ids and offer counts, optionally filtered by name.

q.description: Part of the name to filter by.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for the next page.

ae.discond/discond.name: discond_resolve_place
ae.discond/discond.description: Resolve a UAE place name to Discond place ids (emirate, community, settlement) or to a known area. A known area or landmark (Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall…) has level "area" or "landmark" and id 0; its name works as the place filter of discond_find_discounts.

q.description: Place name to resolve

level.description: What kind of place to look for. auto (default) tries all.

region_id.description: Only places inside this emirate (region id from an earlier result).

community_id.description: Only places inside this community (id from an earlier result).

ae.employerofrecord/moha.name: how_to_hire_in_the_uae
ae.employerofrecord/moha.description: How hiring in the UAE works through Moha, an Employer of Record, for a company with no UAE entity: when it fits, the information needed about the hire and the company, the employee's documents, the steps, the timeline and the prices. No account needed.

ae.employerofrecord/moha.name: get_quote
ae.employerofrecord/moha.description: Monthly and upfront cost of employing one person in the UAE through Moha, an Employer of Record: salary split, employer costs, government fees, insurance, our fee and VAT, plus how long the visa takes. No account needed.

monthly_salary_aed.description: Total monthly package in AED: basic salary plus allowances. Example: 20000.

nationality.description: The employee’s nationality, as a country name. Example: India.

emirate.description: Where they will work. Defaults to Dubai.

inside_uae.description: True if the person is already in the UAE. Defaults to false (coming from abroad).

spouse.description: True if a spouse will move with them on a family visa.

children.description: Children moving with them on family visas.

insurance.description: Health insurance plan. Defaults to standard.

ae.employerofrecord/moha.name: prepare_hire
ae.employerofrecord/moha.description: Prepares one hire in the UAE without an account. Returns the quote and a link: the person opens it, checks the details and creates their Moha account. Moha checks the company before the hire goes ahead. Nothing is charged or sent to the employee before that.

job_title.description: Their job title. It goes on the work permit, so use the real one.

employee_email.description: The employee’s personal email, if known.

start_date.description: Wanted start date, YYYY-MM-DD. At least two weeks from today; earlier dates are moved to the earliest possible.

monthly_salary_aed.description: Total monthly package in AED: basic salary plus allowances. Example: 20000.

nationality.description: The employee’s nationality, as a country name. Example: India.

emirate.description: Where they will work. Defaults to Dubai.

inside_uae.description: True if the person is already in the UAE. Defaults to false (coming from abroad).

spouse.description: True if a spouse will move with them on a family visa.

children.description: Children moving with them on family visas.

insurance.description: Health insurance plan. Defaults to standard.

company_name.description: The hiring company’s name, to prefill the account.

your_name.description: The name of the person you are helping, to prefill the account.

your_email.description: Their work email, on their company’s domain, to prefill the account. Personal, forwarding and throwaway addresses are refused.

ae.employerofrecord/moha.name: prepare_account
ae.employerofrecord/moha.description: Prepares a Moha account without signing in: company profile, the person setting it up, one to ten hires and colleagues to invite. Returns the quotes and one link to confirm. Moha checks the company first; hires go ahead and colleagues are invited only once approved.

you.description: The person setting up the account.

email.description: Their work email, on their company’s domain. Personal, forwarding and throwaway addresses are refused.

job_title.description: Their job title. It goes on the work permit, so use the real one.

employee_email.description: The employee’s personal email, if known.

start_date.description: Wanted start date, YYYY-MM-DD. At least two weeks from today; earlier dates are moved to the earliest possible.

monthly_salary_aed.description: Total monthly package in AED: basic salary plus allowances. Example: 20000.

nationality.description: The employee’s nationality, as a country name. Example: India.

emirate.description: Where they will work. Defaults to Dubai.

inside_uae.description: True if the person is already in the UAE. Defaults to false (coming from abroad).

spouse.description: True if a spouse will move with them on a family visa.

children.description: Children moving with them on family visas.

insurance.description: Health insurance plan. Defaults to standard.

team.description: Colleagues to invite when the account is created, each with a role.

ae.employerofrecord/moha.name: check_prepared_hire
ae.employerofrecord/moha.description: Whether the person opened the link from prepare_hire or prepare_account and created their account yet.

ae.genosys/genosys.name: search_products
ae.genosys/genosys.description: Search the live GENOSYS UAE catalog (Korean professional skincare, haircare, devices, beauty boxes). Use for any "what do you have for..." question. Accepts plain language in English, Russian or Arabic, plus optional filters. Returns name, price in AED (VAT included), size, stock, concerns and the product link.

query.description: What the shopper wants, e.g. "serum for dry skin", "SPF cushion", "hair loss shampoo".

category.description: Category filter, e.g. Serum, Cream, Mask, Cleanser, Toner/Mist, Sun, Cushion BB, Eye care, Scalp/Hair, Beauty Boxes, Device, Microneedling, PRO Solution. Call list_categories for the full list.

concern.description: Skin concern, e.g. hydration, anti-aging, sensitivity, pore-care, brightening, acne-blemishes, eye-care, hair-loss, sun-protection.

max_price_aed.description: Only products at or below this price (AED, VAT included).

locale.description: Language of descriptions and links: en (default), ru or ar. Product names stay in English.

ae.genosys/genosys.name: get_product
ae.genosys/genosys.description: Full details for one product: description, key features, benefits, key ingredients and actives, step-by-step how to use, sizes or shades with prices, and an add-to-bag link. Use the id from search_products (e.g. "18" or "68").

locale.description: Language of descriptions and links: en (default), ru or ar. Product names stay in English.

ae.genosys/genosys.name: recommend_routine
ae.genosys/genosys.description: Ranked product picks for a shopper's skin type and concerns, the same scoring as the skin quiz on genosys.ae. Use when someone describes their skin and asks what to use.

concerns.description: e.g. ["hydration","anti-aging"]. Tags: hydration, anti-aging, sensitivity, pore-care, brightening, acne-blemishes, eye-care, hair, hair-loss.

at_home_only.description: True (default) leaves out professional clinic-only products.

locale.description: Language of descriptions and links: en (default), ru or ar. Product names stay in English.

ae.genosys/genosys.name: list_categories
ae.genosys/genosys.description: All product categories and skin concerns in the live catalog, with product counts. Use to orient before searching.

ae.genosys/genosys.name: create_bag_link
ae.genosys/genosys.description: Build one link that opens genosys.ae with these items already in the shopper's bag, ready to check out. Use when the shopper decides to buy. Products with sizes or shades (see get_product options) need one picked: pass size, or color as its label or value (e.g. "#01 Bright").

ae.genosys/genosys.name: open_checkout
ae.genosys/genosys.description: Show the shopper a checkout form for these items: shade picker where needed, quantities, delivery details (name, email, phone, emirate, address), live total and a button that creates the order and opens secure Stripe payment. Use when the shopper wants to buy. Pass any details the shopper already gave as prefill.

locale.description: Language of descriptions and links: en (default), ru or ar. Product names stay in English.

ae.genosys/genosys.name: place_order
ae.genosys/genosys.description: Create a GENOSYS UAE order from this chat and get a secure Stripe payment link (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Call only after the shopper has confirmed the items, the total and their delivery details. The order is confirmed by email once paid; unpaid orders are not shipped. Delivery is UAE only. Prices are retail AED including VAT.

color.description: Shade label or value, e.g. "#01 Bright".

name.description: Full name of the person receiving the order.

email.description: Receipt and order updates go here. If it matches a GENOSYS account, the order appears in that account.

phone.description: For the courier: UAE number or one with its country code.

address.description: Building or villa, street, area, and apartment number.

locale.description: Language of descriptions and links: en (default), ru or ar. Product names stay in English.

ae.genosys/genosys.name: order_status
ae.genosys/genosys.description: Status and payment of a GENOSYS order. Needs the order number and the email used for the order.

ae.genosys/genosys.name: store_info
ae.genosys/genosys.description: Delivery areas, times and fees, payment methods, returns, contact (WhatsApp, email), apps and policies for GENOSYS UAE.

ae.plantguide/dubai-gardening.name: what_to_plant
ae.plantguide/dubai-gardening.description: What to sow and plant in Dubai in a given month or season, plus what is flowering, fruiting or ready to harvest, the month's verdict, tips, watch-outs and the climate. Defaults to the current month in Dubai. Also returns that month's indoor-plants block (what to buy, pot up and care for indoors) unless you filter to another group. Start here for any 'what should I plant now / in October / in summer' question.

month.description: Month to plan for: 1–12 or a name like "october". Omit for the current month in Dubai. Not with season.

season.description: A whole season instead of one month: winter (Dec–Feb), spring (Mar–May), summer (Jun–Sep) or autumn (Oct–Nov). Not with month.

ae.plantguide/dubai-gardening.name: search_plants

Returns short profiles with links; call get_plant for the full one.

group.description: Only this group: vegetables-herbs, flowers, trees-palms, shrubs-climbers, lawn-grasses, indoor or water.

sun.description: The plant's light need, exact match: full-sun, sun-part-shade, part-shade or shade.

water.description: Highest water need you accept: "low" keeps very-low and low.

minHeat.description: Minimum heat tolerance in Dubai, 1–5 (5 = best).

minShade.description: Minimum shade tolerance, 1–5 (5 = best); use for shady spots.

ae.projectory/mcp.name: search
ae.projectory/mcp.description:
Find published off-plan UAE developments by project name or slug text, combined with exact structured filters. Returns shortlist facts and a pagination cursor. Follow more pages only when the user's task needs them; a page's result count is not a total.

Use `suggest_project_terms` for a partial facet name, `list_project_facets` to explore all filter choices, and `fetch` for selected project detail. A known project URL or slug can go straight to `fetch`.

Prices and price filters apply to the whole development. They do not establish that a particular bedroom count, property type, or unit is available at that price.

query.description: Literal text within a project name or slug; ASCII letter case is ignored. Use structured filters for location, budget and other criteria; this does not interpret natural-language requests.

emirate.description: Exact public API emirate slug from list_project_facets, for example dubai.

developer.description: Exact public API developer slug from list_project_facets, for example sobha-realty.

area.description: Exact public API area slug from list_project_facets, for example dubai-marina.

propertyType.description: Exact public API property type slug from list_project_facets, for example apartment.

bedroomsMin.description: Return developments advertising a bedroom count at or above this value. Zero leaves the filter unset; it does not select studios or identify a unit at a particular price.

priceMinAed.description: Lower bound of the desired development-wide price interval. A development matches when its known range reaches this amount or above; unknown pricing is excluded.

priceMaxAed.description: Upper bound of the desired development-wide price interval. A development matches when its known range starts at or below this amount; unknown pricing is excluded.

newLaunch.description: Filter for projects marked as new launches.

comingSoon.description: Filter for projects marked as coming soon.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 10.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous search call.

ae.projectory/mcp.name: search_transactions
ae.projectory/mcp.description:
Search canonical residential sale registrations in one required market: Dubai or Abu Dhabi. Whole area, project and building names ignore ASCII letter case; provider IDs match exactly. Filters combine with AND; date bounds are inclusive. Returns newest-first pages of 25 rows by default, at most 100. Follow `nextCursor` with the same filters only when more rows are needed for the user's task. A page's row count is not the total number of matching sales.

A bedroom count matches the canonical range; 0 means studio. `sourceProjectId` is a provider identifier, not a Projectory development ID. Partial-name discovery, totals and statistics are not provided. Results do not guarantee real-time freshness.

areaName.description: Whole canonical area name; ASCII letter case is ignored.

projectName.description: Whole canonical project name; ASCII letter case is ignored.

buildingName.description: Whole canonical building name; ASCII letter case is ignored.

sourceProjectId.description: Exact provider project identifier. This is not a Projectory development ID.

from.description: Inclusive sale-registration date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format; year 1900 to 2200.

to.description: Inclusive sale-registration date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format; year 1900 to 2200.

bedrooms.description: Bedroom count to match against each transaction's canonical bedroom range. Use 0 for a studio.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous transaction search page. Reuse the same filters when continuing.

ae.projectory/mcp.name: list_research_reports
ae.projectory/mcp.description:
List citable Projectory Research reports, newest first. Reports analyse registered residential sales from Dubai Land Department (DLD) and Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre (ADREC) transaction records. Each report has a canonical `url` to cite and usually a downloadable `dataset` with its citation, temporal coverage and licence.

`market` dubai returns DLD-based reports and abu-dhabi returns ADREC-based reports; combined reports match both. Returns 10 reports by default, at most 50; there is no pagination. Reports are informational, not financial or investment advice.

period.description: Return reports covering this reporting period.

limit.description: Maximum reports to return. Defaults to 10.

ae.projectory/mcp.name: fetch
ae.projectory/mcp.description:
Fetch one development's detail using a known ID, slug or Projectory URL; no prior search or facet lookup is needed. Returns development-wide pricing, location, availability, enquiry action, payment plan, grouped unit types, evidence, media and a plain-text description marked as untrusted source material. Individual unit rows and raw HTML are omitted.

Accepted forms: `project:jacob-co-beachfront-living`, `jacob-co-beachfront-living`, or `https://projectory.ae/projects/jacob-co-beachfront-living/`. Use `search` if only the project name is known.

id.description: Project ID from search, plain slug, or public Projectory project URL.

ae.projectory/mcp.name: list_project_facets
ae.projectory/mcp.description: Explore all exact values for `emirate`, `area`, `developer`, `propertyType`, `availability` and `sort`, plus boolean flags `newLaunch` and `comingSoon`. Skip this call when the needed slugs are known. Use `suggest_project_terms` for a single partial facet name instead of downloading all choices.

ae.projectory/mcp.name: suggest_project_terms
ae.projectory/mcp.description: Resolve partial emirate, area, developer or property-type text, such as "marina" or "sobha", into exact filter slugs for `search`. Does not search project names. Skip when the exact slug is known; use `list_project_facets` to enumerate all values.

query.description: Partial developer, area, emirate, or property-type text.

aero.events/events.name: search-events
aero.events/events.description: Search upcoming public aviation events on Events.Aero (airshows, fly-ins, workshops and more). Filter by free text, event type, country, date range, distance from a point, free entry or online events. Results are ordered by start date, or by distance when latitude and longitude are given, one page at a time. Every result includes the public event page URL: send people there to book or RSVP.

query.description: Words matched against the event name, venue name, town and location: every word must appear, matched from the start of a word ("dux" finds Duxford); up to 100 characters

type.description: Event type, from list-event-types

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. GB: list-countries lists the live countries; a soft-launched country is answered only when named (without one, only live countries are searched)

from.description: Earliest start date, YYYY-MM-DD: a calendar date matched against each event's own local start date (in the event's timezone)

to.description: Latest start date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive: a calendar date matched against each event's own local start date

latitude.description: Search near this point (with longitude); results are ordered by distance

radius_nm.description: Radius around the point in nautical miles (default 50, at most 500)

aero.events/events.name: get-event
aero.events/events.description: Get one public event by its ID or slug (from search-events or featured-events): dates, venue, price, how to book or RSVP, organiser contact details shown on the event page, flying in (PPR, runway, landing fees and whether pilots can RSVP to fly in), the day's schedule and the description. Always share the event page URL.

aero.events/events.name: featured-events
aero.events/events.description: The events Events.Aero is featuring right now, the same selection as the lead row of the home page, optionally for one country. Each includes its public event page URL.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. GB: list-countries lists the live countries; a soft-launched country is answered only when named

aero.events/events.name: list-event-types
aero.events/events.description: The kinds of aviation event on Events.Aero (airshow, fly-in, workshop and so on), with the value to pass to search-events and the public page that lists each type in a country.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the browse links (default GB): list-countries lists the live countries; a soft-launched country can be named too

aero.events/events.name: list-countries
aero.events/events.description: The countries Events.Aero lists events in, with the code to pass to other tools and each country's public home and events pages.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: find_crops
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Crops that suit a place, best first, with when to plant each. Give a
town or district name ("Murewa", "Nakuru") or a lat/lng. The list is in
Divisi's agronomy order: planting window, then suitability. Each crop links to its guide and its planting page, and lists the services the person can ask Divisi for about it (seed, cover, a loan).

africa.divisi/divisi.name: when_to_plant
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
When to plant one crop at one place: the planting window open now or
next, the other seasons in the year, when harvest falls, and the services
the person can ask Divisi for about it. `crop` is a
name in any language ("maize", "chibage"); give a town or district name,
or a lat/lng.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: identify_problem
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Which pests or diseases might explain what a farmer sees on a crop:
candidates from that crop's Divisi guide, best match first, each with how
to identify it, photos and a link to its page. `symptoms` is the
farmer's own words ("holes in the leaves, sawdust in the funnel"). These
are possibilities to check against the photos, not a diagnosis.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: read_guide
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
The summary of Divisi's guide to one crop, pest or disease, named in
any language: for a crop, its overview, key facts, season stages and the
threats to watch for; for a pest or disease, how to spot it and what to
do. `kind` narrows the search when a name could be either. Links to the
full page.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: market_prices
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
The typical price range Divisi has seen for a product near a place,
per `unit` ("kg", "50 kg bag", "crate"), from listings, deals and
published market prices, with how many prices it rests on. Without a
`unit`, it answers in the unit most prices near there were given in. Give
a town or district name, or a lat/lng. `currency` defaults to the
country's. When
there are too few prices to be honest, it says so instead of guessing.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: find_market
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Where a market is and when it runs. Give a market's `name` ("Mbare
Musika", "Mile 12", "Wakulima"; spelling and the word market do not
matter) or a town, district or lat/lng to see the markets near it, nearest
first. `crop` keeps only markets that trade it. Each market has its town,
country, how far away it is, the days and hours it runs, what is traded,
what is in season this month, and its Divisi page. It gives no
prices.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: find_events
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Upcoming field days, trainings and meetups, soonest first: near a town,
district or lat/lng (within `radius_km`, at most 200), or online.
`search` matches a topic or title. Pages of 20.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: search_market
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Find Market listings: produce and inputs for sale (`kind` SALE) or
what people want to buy (WANTED), near a town, district or lat/lng
(within `radius_km`, at most 100). Prices are per unit as listed, with
the usual local range beside them where Divisi has one, and each seller's
rating and orders handed over, so a buyer can judge the price and the
seller. Pages of 20.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: find_experts
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Verified agronomists, vets and advisers on Divisi, best first: who
they are, what they know, where they are, whether they visit farms near
the place, and what a call or a farm visit costs. `crop` keeps those who
know it; give a town or district, or a lat/lng (a signed-in person's own
farm by default). `name` matches their name. Pages of 10.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: farm_report
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
How the person's farms are doing and what needs them. Per farm: the
weather now, the days ahead and any warning; every crop, flock, herd,
pond and hive with its stage, head count and the day it is ready; money
in and out per unit with the margin worked out; tasks (late ones first);
the latest work with who logged it. Then what waits on the person:
unread conversations and who they are with, offers and deals to act on,
and events they are going to. Leave out `farm_id` to read every farm (up
to five).

africa.divisi/divisi.name: set_up_farm
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Add a farm the person owns. Say where with `lat`/`lng` (best: advice
is then for that spot) or a town or district as `place` (its centre is
used until the spot is set in the app). Divisi fills in the country,
currency and time zone. Pass the same `client_id` (a UUID) to retry
safely.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: update_farm
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Rename a farm, change its description, or move it (`lat`/`lng`, or a
`place`). Only what is passed changes. Only farm owners and managers can
change a farm. `farm_id` may be left out when the person has one farm.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: add_zone
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Add a field, pen, pond or apiary to a farm. A name already used gets a
number added. Only farm owners and managers can add one. Pass the same
`client_id` (a UUID) to retry safely.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: add_unit
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Add something the person grows or keeps, the way the app does, and
Divisi schedules its tasks. `what` is in their words: a crop ("maize"),
or animals ("broilers", "layers", "road runners", "goats", "tilapia",
"bees"); `kind` is worked out from it unless given.

A crop goes on a field: `target_planting_date` is the day they mean to
plant, `planting_date` only if it is already in the ground.
Animals: `count` (needed for poultry), `start_date` (the day they
arrived; today if left out) and optionally `ready_date`, the day they
expect to sell, which is added as a task.

`place` is the field, coop, pen, pond or apiary, by name or id; a new
name makes one. Left out, the farm's only place of that kind is used.
Only farm owners and managers can add one. Pass the same `client_id` (a
UUID) to retry safely.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: log_work
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Write work done, money in or out, or both, into the farm records,
in the person's words. `unit` names the crop or batch it was for (its
name or id); leave it out for the whole farm. `day` defaults to today.

Work: `what`, and optionally `operation` (PLANTING, WEEDING,
FERTILISING, SPRAYING, IRRIGATION, SCOUTING, HARVEST, POST_HARVEST,
LAND_PREP, FEEDING or OTHER).
Money: `amount` with `money` ("income" or "expense"); `category` in
their words or a code (feed, day-old chicks, vaccine, labour, transport,
bird sale, crop sale…), worked out when left out; `currency` defaults to
the farm's; `quantity` is how many were bought or sold (birds sold this
way leave the flock count).

Pass the same `client_id` (a UUID) to retry safely.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: farm_money
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Money in, money out and what is left, worked out: per crop or batch,
for costs of the whole farm, and in total, with the totals by heading
the app's income statement shows and the latest records. `unit` (a name
or id) reads one crop or batch; `since`/`until` limit the days. Leave
out `farm_id` to read every farm.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: add_task
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Add a task to a farm, due on `due_date` (within a year back or two
years ahead), optionally for one crop or batch (`unit`, a name or id).
It shows with the farm's other tasks in the app. Only owners and
managers can add one. Pass the same `client_id` to retry safely.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: update_task
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Look after a task: mark it done (`done`, with an optional `note` of
what was done and the `day`, today if left out), move it to another
`due_date`, or rename it (`title`). `skip` takes it off the list for
this season (a guide's task the person will not do) and `unskip` brings
it back; `remove` deletes a task the person added themselves, and a
task from a guide is skipped instead. Skip, unskip and remove stand
alone. Only what is passed changes. Pass the same `client_id` (a UUID)
to retry safely.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: plan_season
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Write the person's own season plan for one crop or batch (`unit`, a
name or id): the jobs they want and when. Divisi turns each into a task
with a date that moves when they plant or the birds arrive, and shows it
in the app beside the guide's own tasks.

Work the plan out WITH the person and confirm the jobs and days before
you write it. Each task is `name`, `anchor`, `start_day`, optionally
`end_day`, `repeat_every_days` and `notes` (why, or how). `anchor` is
what the days count from: "planting" (the day the crop goes in),
"transplanting", "start of the season" (a crop already growing), or
"arrival" (the day the birds or animals arrive). `start_day` is days
after it (a negative number is before it); `end_day` is the last day it
can still be done, the same as `start_day` if left out. A task that
repeats needs `repeat_every_days` and an `end_day` for how long. At most
80 tasks.

By default the tasks are added to the plan the person already has;
`replace` writes this list instead, and tasks that left the plan come
off their list (work already done stays). Pass the same `client_id` to
retry safely.

SeasonTask.description: One job in a season plan, as the person said it.
SeasonTask.title: SeasonTask

africa.divisi/divisi.name: move_tasks
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Move a crop's or batch's tasks that are not done so the first of
them falls on `start_on`, keeping the gaps between them: when planting
slipped, or the birds came late. Work `start_on` out from what the
person says: "two weeks later" is the current first date plus 14.
`from_date` moves only tasks due on or after that
day; `stage` only those in one stage of the plan. Skipped tasks stay
put, and so do repeating tasks from a guide, which keep their own
rhythm. Confirm the new date with the person first. Safe to retry: once
the first task is on `start_on`, nothing more moves.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: ask_agronomist
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Ask Divisi's agronomists, experts and other farmers by posting the
question in Community as the person. It is public and free; answers come
as replies in the app. `background` is what is known so far (crop stage,
what was tried); the post says it was written with an AI assistant.
Photos only as `{type, id}` refs already on Divisi. Pass the same
`client_id` (a UUID) to retry safely.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: inbox
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
The person's message conversations, newest first, each with who it is with,
how many messages are unread and the last message. `search` matches a
person, group or message text. Pages of 30. Reading marks nothing as
read.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: read_thread
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
The messages in one of the person's conversations, newest first, 30 a
page. Only conversations they are in can be read.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: send_message
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Send a text message as the person: into a conversation they are in
(`conversation_id`), or to a person (`to_person_id`), which opens or
reuses their direct conversation. A first message to someone who does not
follow them is a request the other person accepts first. Blocked people
cannot be messaged. Pass the same `client_id` (a UUID) to retry
safely.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: create_listing
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Put something on the Market as the person, from what they said in
one sentence ("40 broilers ready on the 12th, Harare"): produce for sale
(`kind` SALE) or something they want to buy (WANTED, with a
`quantity`). `item` and `unit` are plain words ("tomatoes", "20 L
bucket"). Left out, a sale takes the unit most local prices use and the
usual local `price` (in major units, such as 12.50), and the place's
currency; say that price to the person. `ready_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 90
days ahead) lists it now as a pre-order. It needs a place: a town, one
of their farms or a lat/lng; with none, their only farm. A sale needs a
photo already on Divisi (`media` as `{type, id}` refs); without one the
reply is the link to the screen where they add it, signed in on the web
or in the app. Reuse `client_id` (a UUID) to retry. Nothing is
charged.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: sell_harvest
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Put a crop or a batch of animals from the person's farm up for sale,
as it nears harvest or slaughter. Divisi fills in what it knows: what it
is and its variety, the farm's place and currency, how many animals the
batch holds today, the day it is ready (listed ahead as a pre-order up
to 90 days early), the unit most local prices use, and the usual local
price when no `price` is given (say that price to the person). Give any
of them to change it. Without `production_unit_id`, their only crop or
batch; with several, the error lists them to choose from. A sale needs a
photo already on Divisi (`media` as `{type, id}` refs); without one the
reply is the link to the screen where they add it, signed in on the web
or in the app. Reuse `client_id` to retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: manage_listing
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Keep one of the person's listings up to date: `renew` keeps it on the
Market (with `quantity_available`, how many are left now), `sold` takes
it down as sold out, `hide` takes it off the Market for now and `show`
puts a hidden one back. Reuse `client_id` to retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: record_sale
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Write down a sale from one of the person's listings that happened
outside Divisi (at the gate, on WhatsApp): `quantity` of the listing's
unit at `price_per_unit`, on `sold_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, today if left out),
to `buyer` if they want a name. What is left on the listing goes down,
and the money goes into the farm's books. Reuse `client_id` to retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: make_offer
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Offer to buy from (or sell to) a listing as the person: `quantity` of
its unit at `price_per_unit` in major units. A buyer chooses how to pay:
`divisi` (the default where Divisi can take the payment: they pay before
meeting and the money is held until they have the goods) or `cash` when
they meet. The reply says which it is. The other person answers in
Divisi. Reuse `client_id` to retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: respond_to_offer
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Answer an offer the person received: `accept` (makes a deal),
`decline`, or `counter` with another `price_per_unit` (and `quantity`,
the same as asked if left out). `withdraw` takes back one they made. A
buyer accepting may choose `pay_with`; otherwise the offer's own choice
stands. The reply says how the deal is paid. Reuse `client_id` to
retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: my_deals
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
The person's Market deals that are still going, as buyer and seller,
most recently changed first (`include_finished` adds closed ones): what
was agreed, how it is paid (cash, or through Divisi), where the money is
(unpaid, held until the buyer has the goods, paid out, refunded, being
checked), where the handover code is, and the one thing to do next. Also
the offers waiting for the person's answer.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: update_deal
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Move one of the person's deals on. A seller: `handed_over` with the
4-digit `code` the buyer shows them (ask the seller for it; never guess),
`more_time` (once) to hand over a deal paid through Divisi. A buyer:
`problem` (`missing`, `wrong` or `damaged`; the money waits until Divisi
decides), `new_code` after too many wrong codes. Saying all is right pays
the seller, so the buyer does that themselves in Divisi, from the deal's
link. Either: `cancel` before handover (a buyer who paid gets it all
back), `no_show` when the other person did not come. No money is paid
here. Reuse `client_id` to retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: pay_deal
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
What paying for one of the person's deals through Divisi takes, and
the page in Divisi where they pay it themselves: how much comes from
their Credit, how much by card (and in which currency the card is
charged), whether their balance covers it, and the fee. The assistant
never pays; give the person the link. Divisi holds the money until they
have the goods and gives it all back if the deal falls through.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: review_deal
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Rate the other person on a finished deal, 1 to 5 `stars`, with a
short `comment` if they want one. Others see it when they decide whether
to trade with them. Reuse `client_id` to retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: reply_to_review
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Answer a rating someone gave the person, once, in their own words.
It shows under the rating.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: my_money
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
The person's money in Divisi: what is theirs to spend or withdraw,
what is coming from sales (held until each buyer has the goods, with the
day it is paid out), money on its way to their bank or phone, anything
they owe, their Credit and when it runs out, refunds coming back to
them, and the fee. `currency` (e.g. USD) keeps only that one. Read
only.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: rsvp
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Take a place at an event as the person. A full event puts them on its
waiting list. Retrying is safe: one place each.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: cancel_rsvp
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Give up the person's place at an event, so the next person waiting
gets it.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: express_interest
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Tell Divisi the person needs a service where they farm, so they are
told when it arrives there. `need`: inputs (seed and fertiliser), finance
(a farm loan), insurance (cover), tractor, transport (to market),
agronomist (an expert visit), soil_test, vet, storage, events (field
days), labour (farm hands) or control (stopping a pest or disease, named
in `pest_or_disease`). `detail` narrows it when asked: inputs seed or
fertiliser; finance inputs, equipment or cash; insurance crop, animals
or family; labour planting or harvest. `crop` names the crop for seed,
fertiliser, loans, crop cover and field days. `remind_on` asks for a
reminder that day instead. The place is their farm's area. This is
demand, not an application: nothing is shared and nothing is paid.
Asking twice keeps one request; pass the same `client_id` to retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: my_requests
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
The services the person has asked Divisi for and still wants, newest
first: waiting, reminders set, and what has reached their area (with
where to get it). `need` keeps one kind, such as tractor.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: withdraw_interest
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Take a service request off the person's list: they no longer need it
and will not be told when it arrives.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: book_consultation
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Ask a verified expert for a call (`virtual`) or a farm visit
(`in_person`, to one of the person's farms) at the time proposed, at the
expert's own price. `topic` is what it is about, in the person's words.
Nothing is paid now: once the expert agrees a time, the person pays in
Divisi at the link in the reply. Confirm the expert, the time and the
price with the person first. Pass the same `client_id` to retry.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: consultation_step
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Take the next step on a consultation, as the person: `propose` another
time (with `starts_at`), `accept` or `decline` the time the other side
proposed, report a `problem` or that the expert was `late` (the farmer,
after the time), `contest` a lateness report or say the farmer did not
come (`no_show`) (the expert), or `reschedule` once after missing it
(the farmer, with `starts_at`). Paying, and saying it went well, are done
in the app.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: cancel_consultation
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Call off a consultation before it starts, either side. A paid booking
is refunded to the farmer in full.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: my_consultations
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
The person's consultations, booked or booked with them, newest first,
each with its next step. `open_only` false includes finished ones.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: find_programmes
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Outgrower schemes and other farmer programmes taking farmers this
season where the person farms (their farm by default, or a town,
district or lat/lng): who runs each, what it offers, the season, what
joining asks them to share, and what it costs them. `crop` keeps those
for that crop.

africa.divisi/divisi.name: apply_to_programme
africa.divisi/divisi.description:
Ask to join a programme as the person. This puts the organisation's
request on their list; nothing is shared until they read it and say yes
in Divisi, at the link in the reply. It never says yes for them. Pass
the same `client_id` to retry.

agency.almostimpossible/site.name: search_site

agency.almostimpossible/site.name: get_page
agency.almostimpossible/site.description: The full text of one public page as Markdown, by its path: "/" (home), "/about", "/process", "/faq", "/awards", "/work/<slug>", "/news/<slug>" and so on. Use it after search_site or list_work to read and cite the page itself.

path.description: The page path, starting with "/", e.g. "/about" or "/work/<slug>".

agency.almostimpossible/site.name: get_agency_overview
agency.almostimpossible/site.description: Fixed facts about Almost Impossible, the independent creative agency in Dubai: legal name, founding date, founder, address, areas served, the three service lines and agency awards. Use it to describe, compare or verify the agency.

agency.almostimpossible/site.name: list_work
agency.almostimpossible/site.description: Published case studies in the agency's own order, 1 to 20 per page, each with client, year and summary. The optional query filters by title, client or summary (e.g. "Mashreq"). Use get_work with a slug for one case study's services and summary.

agency.almostimpossible/site.name: get_work
agency.almostimpossible/site.description: One published case study by its slug (from list_work or search_site): client, year, services, summary, short TL;DR and page URL.

agency.almostimpossible/site.name: list_team
agency.almostimpossible/site.description: The people on the published team page: name, role, whether they are a founder, a one-line summary and LinkedIn. It has no email addresses or phone numbers.

agency.goji/goji.name: goji_search
agency.goji/goji.description: Search GOJI's published material — the plain-English glossary, the AI-visibility guide "Be the Answer", insight articles and long-form guides. Use this first when you don't already know which GOJI page answers the question. Returns titles, summaries and URLs to cite.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "AEO", "website cost", "rebrand"

agency.goji/goji.name: goji_explain_term

Covers every term in GOJI's plain-English glossary. Accepts an acronym or the full name ("AEO" or "answer engine optimisation").

agency.goji/goji.name: goji_browse_glossary
agency.goji/goji.description: List GOJI's plain-English glossary — every term, across AI Visibility, Websites, Measurement, AI Builds and Brand. Filter by category to get each short definition as well as the name.

category.description: Omit for the full A–Z index

agency.goji/goji.name: goji_get_service
agency.goji/goji.description: The four things GOJI does — Search + AI Visibility (SEO and AEO), Websites, AI Builds, and Brand — what each one covers, and the questions clients ask about it. Omit the slug for all of them.

agency.goji/goji.name: goji_answer_faq

Every published answer across the home page, the pricing page, the service pages, the specialism and location pages, and the insight articles. agency.goji/goji.name: goji_guide_contents
agency.goji/goji.description: The table of contents for "Be the Answer", GOJI's guide to AI visibility — how answer engines choose sources, how to audit your brand in ChatGPT, and what to do about it. Use goji_read_guide_chapter to read one.

agency.goji/goji.name: goji_read_guide_chapter

agency.goji/goji.name: goji_read_guide

guide.description: Guide slug, e.g. "website-cost-australia". Omit to list every guide.

agency.goji/goji.name: goji_start_enquiry

language.description: Site language: "pl" (prices in PLN) or "en" (prices in EUR for clients outside Poland).

agency.justidea/justidea-agency.name: get_page
agency.justidea/justidea-agency.description: Full text of one justidea.agency page as Markdown: a service, a price list, the company profile, reviews, a blog article. agency.justidea/justidea-agency.name: search_site

agency.justidea/justidea-agency.name: send_inquiry
agency.justidea/justidea-agency.description: Send a sales inquiry to JustIdea Agency (Kraków, Poland) on behalf of the user. It goes to the agency CRM and the sales team, the sender gets a short confirmation e-mail, and a person replies within one business day. Use only details the user gave you. Never invent a name, e-mail or phone number. Before sending, show the user what will be sent and ask for consent to data processing under the privacy policy (https://justidea.agency/en/privacy-policy/); set zgoda to true only after they agree. Budgets are in PLN net ("tys. zł" = thousand PLN). At most 2 inquiries per e-mail address per day. Urgent matters: phone +48 12 400 40 40.

email.description: Email address for the reply.

telefon.description: Phone number with at least 9 digits, country code welcome.

strona.description: Current website or online store address, optional.

budzet.description: Budget range, exactly one of the listed values, and it must match the service. One-off projects ("sklep", "strona", "audyt", "kreacja", "inne") take a project budget: "do 15 tys. zł", "15-40 tys. zł", "40-80 tys. zł", "80-150 tys. zł", "150-300 tys. zł", "powyżej 300 tys. zł", "jeszcze nie wiem". agency.justidea/justidea-agency.name: scan_analytics
agency.justidea/justidea-agency.description: Free check of how a website or online store measures traffic and sales: Google Tag Manager, GA4 and e-commerce events, consent banner and Consent Mode v2, server-side tagging, Meta Pixel and Conversions API. A real browser visits the site (home, product page, cart) for up to 90 seconds. Returns the grade (A-F), the score and the list of problems, without fixes. The full report with step-by-step fixes and a PDF is sent by JustIdea Agency to the user's e-mail. Use only details the user gave you: never invent or guess an e-mail address. Before calling, tell the user the report goes to their e-mail and ask for consent under the privacy policy (https://justidea.agency/en/privacy-policy/); set zgoda to true only after they agree. At most 2 scans per e-mail address per day. If it returns status "running", call get_scan_result with the scan_id after 30-60 seconds.

url.description: The website to scan: a domain or URL, e.g. "mystore.com". Only the home domain is used.

email.description: The user's own e-mail address. The full report with fixes is sent there, and only there.

zgoda.description: Must be true: the user agreed to receive the report by e-mail, to be contacted by JustIdea about the results, and to the processing of this data under the privacy policy.

phone.description: Optional. The user's phone number, only if they gave it and want a call about the results.

name.description: Optional. The user's first name, only if they gave it.

language.description: Report language. Use "pl" for Polish-speaking users, "en" for everyone else.

agency.justidea/justidea-agency.name: scan_ai_visibility
agency.justidea/justidea-agency.description: Free check of how ready a website is for AI assistants and AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude): whether their crawlers get in (robots.txt, firewalls), whether the content is readable without JavaScript, structured data, llms.txt and the signals models use to cite a source. Takes about 10-30 seconds. Returns the grade (A-F), the score and the list of problems, without fixes. The full report with step-by-step fixes and a PDF is sent by JustIdea Agency to the user's e-mail. Use only details the user gave you: never invent or guess an e-mail address. Before calling, tell the user the report goes to their e-mail and ask for consent under the privacy policy (https://justidea.agency/en/privacy-policy/); set zgoda to true only after they agree. At most 2 scans per e-mail address per day. If it returns status "running", call get_scan_result with the scan_id after 30-60 seconds.

url.description: The website to scan: a domain or URL, e.g. "mystore.com". Only the home domain is used.

email.description: The user's own e-mail address. The full report with fixes is sent there, and only there.

name.description: Optional. The user's first name, only if they gave it.

agency.justidea/justidea-agency.name: scan_google_visibility
agency.justidea/justidea-agency.description: Free check of whether Google can index a website well: Googlebot access in robots.txt and on the server, noindex, canonical, http-to-https and www redirects, the sitemap and whether its URLs answer 200, titles, meta descriptions, H1, structured data, mobile viewport, hreflang and Core Web Vitals from real Chrome users. Takes about 15-60 seconds. Returns the grade (A-F), the score and the list of problems, without fixes. When available, it also returns an Ahrefs estimate of the domain in Google (ranking keywords, monthly organic traffic, Domain Rating, referring domains). These numbers are estimates, not Search Console data, they do not affect the grade, and they are sometimes temporarily unavailable. The report is in Polish. The full report with step-by-step fixes and a PDF is sent by JustIdea Agency to the user's e-mail. Use only details the user gave you: never invent or guess an e-mail address. Before calling, tell the user the report goes to their e-mail and ask for consent under the privacy policy (https://justidea.agency/en/privacy-policy/); set zgoda to true only after they agree. At most 2 scans per e-mail address per day. If it returns status "running", call get_scan_result with the scan_id after 30-60 seconds.

url.description: The website to scan: a domain or URL, e.g. "mystore.com". Only the home domain is used.

email.description: The user's own e-mail address. The full report with fixes is sent there, and only there.

agency.ottobot/business-contact-finder.name: check_contact_path
agency.ottobot/business-contact-finder.description: Given a business website URL, report how a human is meant to make contact and whether that path is actually reachable. Returns a verdict of 'reachable' or 'inconclusive', the forms found with their resolved handler URLs, and any published phone or email. Never submits anything. Answers 'inconclusive' rather than guessing when a site is client-rendered, bot-protected or parked -- about 64% of real sites cannot be judged from outside, and a confident wrong answer is worse than an honest one.

agency.ottobot/contractor-license-change.name: check_license_history

This is change over time, not a current-status lookup: use it after a snapshot check, to find out whether the licence you are about to rely on lapsed and came back. Distinguishes 'no change observed' from 'this source is not observed for that change', which are not the same answer. Only public, unsuppressed directory records are returned. Read-only.

Answers the monitoring question a single lookup cannot -- which contractors lost standing this month, or who is newly licensed in this trade. Read-only.

state.patternMessage: argument state must be a two-letter state code, e.g. CA

blueprint_id.description: From list_my_blueprints. Optional when the address has one Blueprint.

agency.zoll/ausfuhr.name: kumulierung_pruefen
agency.zoll/ausfuhr.description: Darf Vormaterial aus einem Partnerland der EU für den Ursprung der fertigen Ware zählen, wenn sie in ein bestimmtes Land verkauft wird? Nach der Pan-Europa-Mittelmeer-Kumulierung und den Abkommen mit dem Vereinigten Königreich, Japan, Kanada, Südkorea und dem Mercosur, mit dem Vermerk für den Ursprungsnachweis. Ob die Ware die Listenregel ihres Kapitels erfüllt, sagt das Werkzeug nicht.

vormaterial.description: 1. Woher stammt das Vormaterial? Das Land, in dem das Vormaterial seinen Ursprung hat, nicht das Land, aus dem es verschickt wurde. Ländercode nach ISO 3166 (zwei Großbuchstaben): EU (aus der EU), AL (Albanien), DZ (Algerien), AR (Argentinien), BA (Bosnien und Herzegowina), BR (Brasilien), FO (Färöer), GE (Georgien), IS (Island), IL (Israel), JP (Japan), JO (Jordanien), CA (Kanada), KO (Kosovo), LB (Libanon), LI (Liechtenstein), MA (Marokko), ME (Montenegro), MK (Nordmazedonien), NO (Norwegen), PS (Palästina), PY (Paraguay), MD (Republik Moldau), CH (Schweiz und Liechtenstein), RS (Serbien), SY (Syrien), KR (Südkorea), TN (Tunesien), TR (Türkei), UA (Ukraine), UY (Uruguay), GB (Vereinigtes Königreich), EG (Ägypten)

bestimmungsland.description: 2. Wohin verkaufen Sie die fertige Ware? Ländercode nach ISO 3166 (zwei Großbuchstaben)

behandlungen.description: 3. Was haben Sie in der EU mit dem Vormaterial gemacht? Kreuzen Sie alles an, was zutrifft. Es zählt alles zusammen, was in Ihrem Betrieb an der Ware gemacht wurde. Ein oder mehrere Schlüssel, je einer für eine Bearbeitung in der EU: erhalten = für Transport oder Lagerung haltbar gemacht; packstuecke = Packstücke geteilt oder zusammengestellt; reinigen = gewaschen, gereinigt, entstaubt, entrostet oder Farbe entfernt; buegeln = Textilien gebügelt; anstreichen = einfach angestrichen oder poliert; reis = Reis geschält oder gemahlen, Getreide oder Reis poliert; zucker = Zucker gefärbt, aromatisiert, gemahlen, zu Würfeln geformt oder mit anderem gemischt; schaelen = Früchte, Nüsse oder Gemüse geschält, entkernt oder enthülst; schaerfen = geschärft, einfach geschliffen oder einfach zerteilt; sortieren = gesiebt, sortiert oder zu Sortimenten zusammengestellt; verpacken = einfach abgefüllt oder verpackt; kennzeichnen = Marken, Etiketten oder Logos angebracht; mischen = einfach gemischt; verduennen = Wasser zugegeben, verdünnt, getrocknet oder denaturiert; zusammenfuegen = einfach zusammengefügt oder zerlegt (ohne Fachpersonal und ohne eigens dafür gebaute Maschinen); schlachten = Tiere geschlachtet; andere = Etwas anderes: zum Beispiel in eine Maschine eingebaut, von Fachleuten montiert, geformt, gegossen, genäht, bedruckt oder chemisch umgewandelt

nachweis.description: 4. Haben Sie einen Nachweis für den Ursprung des Vormaterials? Vom Lieferanten im Partnerland: EUR.1 oder Ursprungserklärung auf der Rechnung. Vom Lieferanten in der EU: Lieferantenerklärung oder Langzeit-Lieferantenerklärung. „ja“ oder „nein“

agency.zoll/ausfuhr.name: praeferenznachweis_bestimmen
agency.zoll/ausfuhr.description: Welcher Präferenznachweis gilt für die Ausfuhr aus der EU in ein Land (EUR.1, A.TR, Erklärung zum Ursprung auf der Rechnung, REX), mit Wertgrenze und Wortlaut der Erklärung. Zeigt die Regeln des Abkommens für das Land, keine Aussage über den Ursprung der Ware.

land.description: In welches Land geht die Sendung? Ländercode nach ISO 3166 (zwei Großbuchstaben)

warenwert_eur.description: Warenwert der Sendung in EUR. Der Wert aller Waren dieser Sendung laut Rechnung, in Euro. Zahl in Euro, ab 0

agency.zoll/ausfuhr.name: incoterms_waehlen
agency.zoll/ausfuhr.description: Ordnet Antworten zu Transportweg, Fracht, Gefahrübergang, Versicherung, Einfuhrabgaben und Abladen einer Klausel der Incoterms® 2020 zu, mit der Angabe für Feld 14 01 der Ausfuhranmeldung. Die Wahl trifft der Nutzer mit seinem Vertragspartner. Die Fragen stehen aus Sicht des Verkäufers; wer aus einem Land außerhalb der EU einkauft, beantwortet sie für seinen Lieferanten. Für den Zollwert der Einfuhr zählen Fracht und Versicherung bis zur EU-Grenze mit (Art. 71 UZK), auch bei EXW oder FCA.

weg.description: Wie reist die Ware? Vier Klauseln gelten nur für Ware, die direkt ans Schiff geht. Container geben Sie schon vorher am Terminal ab. Antworten, die für den Weg zur Klausel nicht zählen, bleiben unbeachtet. Werte: jeder = Mit Paketdienst, Lkw, Bahn, Flugzeug oder im Container, auch wenn der Container aufs Schiff geht; schiff = Lose oder als Massengut direkt ans Schiff (See- oder Binnenschiff)

fracht.description: Wer bezahlt den Haupttransport ins Zielland? Antworten, die für den Weg zur Klausel nicht zählen, bleiben unbeachtet. Werte: kunde = Mein Kunde. Ich bringe die Ware höchstens bis zur Übergabe an seinen Frachtführer oder ans Schiff.; sie = Ich, bis zum Bestimmungsort oder Bestimmungshafen im Zielland.

gefahr.description: Ab wann trägt Ihr Kunde die Gefahr, dass die Ware verloren geht oder beschädigt wird? Antworten, die für den Weg zur Klausel nicht zählen, bleiben unbeachtet. Werte: bereit = Sobald die Ware bei mir bereitsteht, noch nicht verladen; frachtfuehrer = Sobald ich sie dem ersten Frachtführer übergebe, bei mir verladen oder an einem vereinbarten Ort; laengsseits = Sobald sie im Verschiffungshafen neben dem Schiff liegt (nur Schiff); bord = Sobald sie im Verschiffungshafen an Bord ist (nur Schiff); bestimmung = Erst wenn sie am Bestimmungsort im Zielland ankommt

versicherung.description: Schließen Sie eine Transportversicherung für die Ware ab? Nur wenn Sie bis ins Zielland bezahlen und die Gefahr schon vorher übergeht. Antworten, die für den Weg zur Klausel nicht zählen, bleiben unbeachtet. Werte: ja = Ja, ich versichere den Transport; nein = Nein

einfuhr.description: Zahlen Sie auch Zoll und Steuern bei der Einfuhr im Zielland? Nur wenn die Gefahr erst am Bestimmungsort übergeht. Antworten, die für den Weg zur Klausel nicht zählen, bleiben unbeachtet. Werte: ja = Ja, ich liefere verzollt; nein = Nein, das zahlt mein Kunde

entladen.description: Laden Sie die Ware am Bestimmungsort ab? Antworten, die für den Weg zur Klausel nicht zählen, bleiben unbeachtet. Werte: ja = Ja, mit Abladen; nein = Nein, mein Kunde lädt ab

agency.zoll/ausfuhr.name: warennummer_suchen
agency.zoll/ausfuhr.description: Sucht mit Wörtern oder einer Nummer (2 bis 11 Ziffern) in der Kombinierten Nomenklatur und zeigt höchstens 10 Codes mit dem amtlichen Wortlaut, nach Code sortiert, ohne Rangfolge. Die achtstellige Warennummer gilt für Ausfuhr und Einfuhr; die 9. und 10. Stelle (TARIC) für die Einfuhranmeldung zeigt das Werkzeug nicht. Die Auswahl trifft der Nutzer. Verbindlich ist nur eine verbindliche Zolltarifauskunft (vZTA).

suchtext.description: Ware oder Nummer (z. B. Kugellager oder 8482 10 90)

agency.zoll/ausfuhr.name: ausfuhranmeldung_noetig
agency.zoll/ausfuhr.description: Der Satz der Vorprüfung von zoll.agency für Bestimmungsland, Warenwert und Gewicht der ganzen Lieferung, nach der Grenze von 1.000 EUR und 1.000 kg (Art. 137 UZK-DA), dazu was je nach Versandweg gilt. Ohne Rechnung; Verbote, Beschränkungen und Rückware berücksichtigt es nicht.

bestimmungsland.description: Wohin geht die Ware? Ländercode nach ISO 3166 (zwei Großbuchstaben)

warenwert_eur.description: Warenwert der Sendung in EUR. Zahl in Euro, ab 0

gewicht_kg.description: Eigenmasse aller Waren der Lieferung in kg, ohne Verpackung (freiwillig)

versandweg.description: Versandweg (freiwillig): dhl_paket = Paket mit der Post (DHL Paket), paketdienst = anderer Paket- oder Kurierdienst, eigen = eigenes Fahrzeug oder Abholung durch den Kunden

agency.zoll/ausfuhr.name: ratgeber_suchen
agency.zoll/ausfuhr.description: Sucht in den Seiten von zoll.agency zu Einfuhr und Ausfuhr (Ratgeber, Themen, Werkzeuge, Leistungen) wie das Suchfeld der Seite und gibt höchstens 10 Treffer mit Titel, einem Satz und Adresse zurück.

agency.zoll/ausfuhr.name: einfuhr_weg_bestimmen
agency.zoll/ausfuhr.description: Der Einfuhr-Wegweiser von zoll.agency: Für eine Sendung aus einem Land außerhalb der EU, nach Empfänger (Firma oder privat), Versandweg (Post, Kurier, Spedition), Wert bis oder über 150 EUR und ob sie schon beim Zollamt liegt, wer sie in der Regel anmeldet (Post, Kurier, Spediteur oder der Empfänger selbst in der Internetzollanmeldung IZA) und was der Empfänger tut, mit Quelle. Liegen Versendungsland oder Ursprung in Russland, Belarus, Iran oder Nordkorea, oder wurde die Ware aus Russland oder Belarus ausgeführt, kommt stattdessen der Stopp mit Verordnung und Fassung auf EUR-Lex. Zoll und Einfuhrumsatzsteuer rechnet das Werkzeug nicht.

wer.description: Wer empfängt die Sendung? Werte: firma = eine Firma; privat = eine Privatperson

weg.description: Wie kommt die Sendung? Werte: post = mit der Post (Deutsche Post, DHL Paket, ausländische Post); kurier = mit einem Kurier oder Expressdienst (DHL Express, UPS, FedEx, TNT); spedition = mit einer Spedition (Luftfracht, Seefracht, Lkw)

wert.description: Welchen Wert haben die Waren, ohne Versand? Werte: bis = bis 150 EUR; ueber = über 150 EUR

zollamt.description: Nur bei der Post: Liegt die Sendung schon beim Zollamt? Nur bei der Post nötig, sonst unbeachtet: ja = Benachrichtigung vom Zollamt liegt vor, nein = Sendung ist noch unterwegs.

versendungsland.description: Land, in dem der Lieferant sitzt oder aus dem die Ware versandt wird (freiwillig, für den Stopp bei Sanktionsländern). Ländercode nach ISO 3166 (zwei Großbuchstaben)

ursprungsland.description: Ursprungsland der Ware (freiwillig, für den Stopp bei Sanktionsländern). Ländercode nach ISO 3166 (zwei Großbuchstaben)

aus_russland_oder_belarus_ausgefuehrt.description: Wurde die Ware aus Russland oder Belarus ausgeführt? Freiwillig: „ja“ oder „nein“

agency.zoll/ausfuhr.name: vorpruefung
agency.zoll/ausfuhr.description: Die Vorprüfung von zoll.agency mit den Angaben einer Handelsrechnung, die der Assistent aus der Rechnung übernimmt: Versender und Empfänger mit Land, Positionen mit Beschreibung, Menge, Wert, Ursprung, Gewicht und Warennummer, Währung, Lieferbedingung, Fracht und Versicherung, Nummer und Datum der Rechnung. Die Richtung folgt aus den Ländern: Versender außerhalb der EU und Empfänger in Deutschland ist eine Einfuhr, Versender in Deutschland und Empfänger außerhalb der EU eine Ausfuhr. Ausfuhr: ob eine elektronische Ausfuhranmeldung nötig ist (EU, Sondergebiete, Sanktionsländer, Rückware, Veredelung, Wert und Gewicht, Anmeldung nachholen), was auf der Rechnung fehlt, Präferenznachweis. Einfuhr: Stopp bei Russland, Belarus, Iran und Nordkorea, wer die Sendung anmeldet, Waren mit Verboten oder Beschränkungen, Rechenprobe der Rechnung, was fehlt, Treffer der Warennummernsuche und geschätzte Abgaben. Ist eine Anmeldung über zoll.agency möglich, speichert das Werkzeug die Angaben zur Übernahme und gibt einen Link zurück, der 24 Stunden gilt; ohne Übernahme werden die Angaben danach gelöscht. Die Anmeldung erstellt der Nutzer nach der Anmeldung auf zoll.agency mit der hochgeladenen Rechnung. Nur aufrufen, wenn der Nutzer eine konkrete Rechnung vorprüfen will. Keine Zollberatung und keine Prüfung des Einzelfalls.

name.description: Name der Firma wie auf der Rechnung

versender.description: Versender: der Verkäufer auf der Rechnung. Bei der Ausfuhr die Firma des Nutzers in Deutschland.

name.description: Name der Firma oder Person wie auf der Rechnung

art.description: Einfuhr: firma = Empfänger ist ein Unternehmen, privat = Privatperson

empfaenger.description: Empfänger: der Käufer oder Warenempfänger auf der Rechnung. Bei der Einfuhr die Firma des Nutzers in Deutschland.

warennummer.description: Warennummer, wenn die Rechnung eine nennt: 8, 10 oder 11 Ziffern ohne Leerzeichen

positionen.description: Die Warenpositionen der Rechnung, höchstens 20. Fracht, Versicherung, Rabatt und Steuer sind keine Positionen.

rechnungsbetrag.description: Gesamtbetrag der Rechnung in Rechnungswährung (für die Rechenprobe)

fracht.description: Fracht auf der Rechnung in Rechnungswährung

versicherung.description: Versicherung auf der Rechnung in Rechnungswährung

beschraenkte_waren.description: Gruppen mit Verboten, Beschränkungen oder besonderen Pflichten, die nach Angabe des Nutzers in der Sendung sind. Leere Liste: keine davon. Weglassen, wenn der Nutzer es nicht angegeben hat. Werte: alkohol = Wein, Bier, Spirituosen; tabak = Tabakwaren; energie = Kraftstoffe, Heizöl, Flüssiggas; kaffee = Kaffee und Waren mit Kaffee; tierisch = Tiere und Lebensmittel vom Tier; lebensmittel = Lebens- und Futtermittel aus Pflanzen; pflanzen = Pflanzen, Saatgut, frisches Obst und Gemüse, Rohholz; artenschutz = Waren aus geschützten Arten; arzneimittel = Arzneimittel und Wirkstoffe, auch für Tiere; medizinprodukte = Medizinprodukte; betaeubungsmittel = Betäubungsmittel und Drogenausgangsstoffe; kosmetik = Kosmetik und Körperpflege; chemikalien = Chemikalien und Gemische; biozide = Biozide und Pflanzenschutzmittel; duengemittel = Düngemittel; gefahrgut = Gefahrgut im Transport; pyrotechnik = Feuerwerk und Explosivstoffe; waffen = Waffen und Munition; messer_verboten = Verbotene Messer und Waffen; messer = Messer, Schwerter, Dolche; kriegswaffen = Kriegswaffen; dualuse = Güter mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck, Rüstungsgüter; kulturgut = Kunst, Antiquitäten, archäologische Funde; produktsicherheit = Verbraucher- und CE-Produkte; lebensmittelkontakt = Geschirr, Besteck, Küchen- und Tischartikel; textilien = Kleidung, Heimtextilien, Schuhe; registrierung = Elektrogeräte, Batterien, verpackte Ware zum Weiterverkauf; produktpiraterie = Markenware nicht direkt vom Markeninhaber; entwaldung = Kaffee, Kakao, Soja, Palmöl, Kautschuk, Rinder, Holz, Papier (EUDR); abfall = Abfälle; bargeld = Bargeld, Gold, Inhaberpapiere; einfuhrverbote = Hunde- oder Katzenfell, Robbenerzeugnisse, Folterwerkzeuge, Quecksilber, Rohdiamanten; muenzen = Medaillen oder Münzstücke, die Euro-Münzen ähneln; falschgeld = Falschgeld oder Drucke, die Geldscheinen ähneln; verpackungsholz = Ware in Holzkisten oder auf Holzpaletten; sanktionen = Waren aus Russland oder Belarus

kommt_zurueck.description: Ausfuhr, kommt die Ware zurück? nein = endgültige Ausfuhr, unveraendert = kommt unverändert zurück (Messe, Muster, Werkzeug), veredelung = kommt nach Reparatur oder Bearbeitung zurück

schon_ausgefuehrt.description: Ausfuhr: ja = die Ware hat die EU schon verlassen (Anmeldung nachholen), nein = sie geht noch hinaus

beim_zollamt.description: Einfuhr mit der Post: ja = Benachrichtigung vom Zollamt liegt vor, nein = Sendung ist noch unterwegs

aus_russland_oder_belarus_ausgefuehrt.description: Einfuhr: Wurde die Ware aus Russland oder Belarus ausgeführt? ja oder nein

praeferenznachweis.description: Einfuhr: Liegt ein Präferenznachweis vor (für die geschätzten Abgaben)? ja oder nein

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: list_rule_sets
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: List every deadline rule set 1Court covers, with rule counts and scope. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county. Use the rule_set ids with search_rules, get_rule and calculate_deadline.

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: search_rules
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: Find deadline rules by plain words (for example "opposition to motion", "answer complaint", "notice of appeal"). Searches rule names, ids, citations and triggers. Optionally limit to one rule_set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Returns up to 20 rules with their rule_set, rule_id and rule page URL; use get_rule or calculate_deadline next.

query.description: Words describing the deadline, e.g. "opposition to motion" or "CCP 1005"

rule_set.description: Optional rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: get_rule
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: Get one deadline rule: its period, trigger, citation, the verbatim rule text, the official source URL, the 1Court rule page, any disclosed alternate reading (safe-date policy) and any fixed statutory dates. Show the user the citation and source link with every date or rule. Results are not legal advice.

rule_set.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

rule_id.description: Rule id from search_rules or list_deadline_rules

county.description: California county slug, to include that county’s local rules

court.description: Court id for local rules (cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, 1dca to 6dca)

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: list_triggers
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: List the trigger events ("what happened": summons served, motion hearing date, trial date, notice of entry of judgment served...) that a court's deadline rules run from, for one rule set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Each trigger shows how many deadlines it starts, whether the service method changes the dates, and, for broad triggers, the kinds you can narrow to (for a motion hearing: noticed motion, summary judgment...). Use with deadlines_from_trigger. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

rule_set.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

county.description: California county slug for local rules, e.g. "los-angeles" (CA sets only)

court.description: Court id for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, 1dca to 6dca

query.description: Optional words to filter triggers, e.g. "subpoena" or "served"

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: deadlines_from_trigger
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: Every deadline that follows one trigger event, like a docketing system: court, trigger, date in; all resulting deadlines out, each with its date, the rule citation, the official source and the 1Court rule page. Deadlines that apply only to some case types (limited civil, asbestos, PI Pathway...) are listed separately. For broad triggers (a motion hearing covers every motion type), pass kind to narrow (e.g. "Noticed motion", "Motion for summary judgment"); otherwise the usual kind is chosen and the rest are listed as other_deadlines. Ask the user for the trigger date and how the paper was served; do not assume them. Show the user the citation and source link with every date or rule. Results are not legal advice. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

rule_set.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

date.description: Date of the trigger event, YYYY-MM-DD

county.description: California county slug for local rules, e.g. "los-angeles"

court.description: Court id for local rules (federal and appellate)

service_method.description: How the triggering paper (or the summons) was served, from the trigger's service_options. Omit for personal service.

kind.description: For broad triggers, the kind to select (from list_triggers kinds), or "all"

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: list_deadline_rules
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: List the deadline types 1Court can calculate for one rule set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Add county (California superior court, e.g. los-angeles) or court (cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9 for US and US-CRIM; cacb, canb, casb, caeb for US-BK; 1dca to 6dca for CA-APP) to include local rules. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

state.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

court.description: Court for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9 (US); cacb, canb, casb, caeb (US-BK); 1dca, 2dca, 3dca, 4dca, 5dca, 6dca (CA-APP)

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: calculate_deadline
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: Calculate a court deadline from cited rules (weekends, court holidays, service extensions and local rules applied). Ask the user for the trigger date and how the paper was served; do not assume them. Show the user the citation and source link with every date or rule. Results are not legal advice. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

state.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

county.description: California county slug, to use that superior court's local rules and closures

court.description: Court id for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, or 1dca to 6dca (CA-APP)

deadline_type.description: Rule id from search_rules or list_deadline_rules, e.g. "noticed_motion_opposition"

service_method.description: How the triggering paper was served, e.g. "mail" (TX), "mail_in_state", "electronic", "substituted" (CA). Omit for personal service.

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: list_states
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: List the U.S. states in the 1Court Directory, with how many counties each has. Use this to discover coverage before looking up a county.

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: list_counties
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: List the counties covered in a U.S. state (full name, 2-letter code or slug), each with its 1Court page URL.

ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: Get verified court information for one U.S. county: clerk contacts, courthouse address, e-filing provider and whether it is mandatory, filing fees, case lookup, self-help, jury service and payment links, with the date it was last verified. civil_filing_fee is null when not yet verified (fee_status "unknown"), and some counties have no fixed fee (fee_status "clerk_sets_deposit"). Tell the user to confirm fees with the clerk before filing, and cite the 1Court page URL.

state.description: State name, 2-letter code, or slug, e.g. "Texas", "TX"

ai.1court.state/court-directory.name: search_courts
ai.1court.state/court-directory.description: Search the 1Court Directory by county or state name, courthouse name, city, or phone number. Returns matching counties and courthouses with their 1Court page URLs.

query.description: A county, state, courthouse name, city or phone number, e.g. "Maricopa", "Van Nuys courthouse", "Jersey City", "201-748-0156"

ai.28in28/agent-service-desk.name: checkDomain
ai.28in28/agent-service-desk.description: Reads the public DNS of one domain and reports SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT findings, risks, unknowns and the exact DNS changes to fix them. Read-only; nothing is stored.

ai.28in28/agent-service-desk.name: quoteFixVerify
ai.28in28/agent-service-desk.description: Runs the email-authentication check of one domain and returns a machine-readable, NON-BINDING quote for Fix & Verify: price (EUR 99 net per domain), scope (exact DNS changes), acceptance criteria and the baseline to verify against later. Orders are not open: it creates no order, contract or payment and stores nothing. Keep the returned criteria and baseline to call verifyFixVerify after the records are published.

ai.28in28/agent-service-desk.name: verifyFixVerify
ai.28in28/agent-service-desk.description: Re-runs the check of the domain and compares it with the acceptance criteria and baseline of an earlier quoteFixVerify result: PASS when every criterion is resolved and no new critical or high finding appeared. Read-only; nothing is stored; a pass is not an invoice while orders are closed.

token.description: next.verify.arguments.token from the quote

ai.4ai/domains.name: search_domains
ai.4ai/domains.description: Search the 4ai.ai portfolio of premium .ai domain names for sale. Filter by a word in the name, a category (see list_categories), type and maximum length. Every result has an offer link.
