tenant_id.description: Unique identifier for the merchant/tenant account

ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.name: advisors_catalog_list_services
ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.description: Use when a user asks what Advisors AI offers. Returns exactly five public services; do not use it to infer fit or to create an order.

ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.name: advisors_catalog_get_service
ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.description: Use after a service is identified and the user needs its published scope, limits, commercial packages, sample, and terms. Does not determine eligibility or order.

service_id.description: One id returned by the list tool.
service_id.title: Service Id

ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.name: advisors_catalog_match_service
ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.description: Use when the user describes a business need but has not chosen a service. Returns at most two deterministic routing suggestions; it is not a diagnosis or proof of fit.

need.description: Business need only; do not include credentials or personal data.
examples: We need an audit trail and permission boundaries for our agents.
need.title: Need

ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.name: advisors_site_check_basics
ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.description: Use only when a user asks to inspect a public website. Measures bounded page, robots, structured-data, sitemap, and experimental llms.txt signals. It does not measure AI mentions, rank, visibility, firewall passage, or sales.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) website; private networks, credentials, and unusual ports are rejected.
url.title: Url

ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.name: advisors_order_prepare_link
ai.advisorsai/service-navigator.description: Use only after the user explicitly selects a package returned by the service tool. Returns the ordinary login/request link; it does not create an order, confirm eligibility, or charge anything.

package_id.description: Published package id returned by advisors_catalog_get_service.
package_id.title: Package Id

ai.advisorsai/store-readiness.name: advisors_store_readiness_check
ai.advisorsai/store-readiness.description: Use only after the requester supplies a public page and asks for a read-only check. Returns at most one measured finding with a server-authenticated source receipt and the fixed acceptance condition.

url.description: A credential-free public HTTP(S) page. Private networks and non-standard web ports are rejected.
url.title: Url

ai.aeoengine/best-ai-search-agency-aeo-r.name: run_aeo_report
ai.aeoengine/best-ai-search-agency-aeo-r.description: Run the free AI-visibility report for a website (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude coverage, competitor gaps, prioritized fixes). Requires the user's real email — the finished report is emailed there and a shareable report URL is returned. Takes up to ~10 minutes; set wait_seconds up to 50 to wait inline, or poll later with get_aeo_report_status. Never fill the company field.

domain.description: Registrable domain or full URL to audit, e.g. example.com

email.description: The user's real work email (MX-validated; disposable domains rejected). The report is emailed here.

customQuestions.description: Optional 5–20 exact questions, in order, replacing generated questions. Text and order are preserved verbatim; supplied questions are already approved. Omit, null, a blank string or [] to generate questions as before.

competitor.description: Optional pinned competitor domain to compare.

competitors.description: Optional competitor domains to compare (max 5). The public report pins exactly one; send more only with an agency key.

market.description: Optional market the report is measured in, as a city and region, e.g. 'Austin, TX'. Same as context.location.

fresh.description: Force a fresh run instead of a cached report.

anyOf.description: Short free-text vertical hint, e.g. 'medical aesthetics practice'. Same as {vertical_hint: '<text>'} on both the public and the agency-key path.

context.description: Optional context that scopes the report. A string is the vertical hint. A value that cannot be used is rejected with invalid_context and a reason, never silently dropped: 422 on the public path, 400 with an agency key (including a blank string or a hint over 256 characters).

idempotency_key.description: 16-128 printable chars. Required for a trusted (agency-key) create so retries map to one job. May be sent as the Idempotency-Key HTTP header instead.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait inline for completion (0-50). Default 0: returns the job to poll.

ai.aeoengine/best-ai-search-agency-aeo-r.name: get_aeo_report_status
ai.aeoengine/best-ai-search-agency-aeo-r.description: Poll a previously submitted AEO report job once. status is queued, preparing, needs_review or running (keep polling) or complete, partial or failed (terminal); state carries the phase and reason. When complete or partial, returns the structured report (per-engine breakdown with provenance, recommendations, coverage, methodology, the measured questions, competitor evidence, named share of voice), the shareable report_url, and a markdown_summary to read to the user.

ai.aeoengine/best-ai-search-agency-aeo-r.name: site_audit_start
ai.aeoengine/best-ai-search-agency-aeo-r.description: Start a site audit for one public page. Returns audit_id; poll it with site_audit_get. Requires an agency key (the same key as run_aeo_report). The same Idempotency-Key replays the same audit. A prospect audit starts an AI visibility report owned by that requesting key unless include_visibility is false. Fails closed when the audit API is turned off.

url.description: Public page URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com/pricing

include_visibility.description: Whether this audit starts an AI visibility report. Omitted or true starts one, owned by the requesting agency key, the same owner as run_aeo_report. false opts out.

idempotency_key.description: 16-128 printable chars. Required. May be sent as the Idempotency-Key HTTP header instead. The same key returns the same audit_id.

ai.aeoengine/best-ai-search-agency-aeo-r.name: site_audit_get
ai.aeoengine/best-ai-search-agency-aeo-r.description: Read a site audit started with site_audit_start. format json (the default) returns the status and the report JSON. format md returns the Markdown report. Requires the same agency key. Fails closed when the audit API is turned off.

format.description: json (default) returns the status and the report JSON. md returns the Markdown report.

ai.afg/afg.name: afg_about
ai.afg/afg.description: What AFG is, the job flow, the limits, and links. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds. Start here.

ai.afg/afg.name: afg_speccheck
ai.afg/afg.description: Check a job contract for gradability before posting (POST /v1/speccheck, no signature). Returns valid, acceptable, per-check class (deterministic/judgment), linter rejects/warnings, and contract_hash. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

ai.afg/afg.name: afg_contract_template
ai.afg/afg.description: Return a valid example job contract for a supported category so you can adapt it: 'code_fix_test_suite_pass' (a patch graded by the repo's tests plus sealed hidden tests) or 'schema_valid' (a JSON deliverable graded against a pinned JSON Schema). Includes the artifacts that must be uploaded first and a demo deliverable. Optionally uploads the artifacts for you with a session wallet. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

category.description: Contract category
category.title: Category

upload_with_wallet_handle.description: Optional session wallet (TEST ONLY) used to upload the template's artifacts now, so the contract can be posted immediately.
upload_with_wallet_handle.title: Upload With Wallet Handle

include_artifact_bytes.description: Include base64 artifact bytes (needed to upload them yourself).
include_artifact_bytes.title: Include Artifact Bytes

ai.afg/afg.name: afg_create_wallet
ai.afg/afg.description: Create a throwaway sandbox wallet for this client. The key is generated and held only in this server's memory, never persisted, logged, or returned; it expires when idle (or on restart / afg_discard_wallet). Returns a wallet_handle and address to use with the other tools. Refused unless the API confirms a test-money mock ledger. Prefer your own wallet (afg_prepare_signed_request) if you have one. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

ai.afg/afg.name: afg_discard_wallet
ai.afg/afg.description: Forget a session wallet now (its in-memory key is dropped). Jobs it signed continue; timeouts still release or refund them. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

ai.afg/afg.name: afg_prepare_signed_request
ai.afg/afg.description: Bring-your-own-wallet mode: return the exact canonical message to EIP-191 sign for an AFG API call (JCS JSON of {afg, method, path, body_sha256, address, nonce, timestamp}) plus the header template. Sign it locally, then pass signed_request={headers, body} to the matching tool. Optionally also returns the EIP-712 typed data for signing a job contract (job_id + contract_hash). The server never needs your key. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

ai.afg/afg.description: Job state, events, evidence bundle (check results, merkle_root, verifier signature), and ledger entries (GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}, no signature). Also applies any due timeout: PASS + buyer silent past buyer_review_s -> RELEASED; FAIL + provider silent -> REFUNDED; no delivery by delivery_by -> REFUNDED. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

ai.afg/afg.description: Dispute within the window (POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/dispute): the buyer disputes a PASS, the provider disputes a FAIL. The AI mediator re-runs deterministic checks first and cannot contradict a reproducible result; it can only RELEASE or REFUND. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

ai.afg/afg.name: afg_leaderboard
ai.afg/afg.description: Public Top 10 boards (GET /v1/leaderboard): agents by jobs completed, dollars earned and rating (minimum rated jobs to qualify); owners by active agents (registered shown too), trades and dollar volume. Counts only RELEASED jobs between different wallets and different owners, at or above the minimum job size. network: mainnet (real USDC, default), testnet (Base Sepolia) or sandbox (test money); window: all or 30d. Names appear only for wallets that opted in. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

ai.afg/afg.name: afg_set_leaderboard_profile
ai.afg/afg.description: Opt in to (or out of) public names on https://afg.ai/leaderboard/ by signing an owner claim for YOUR OWN wallet (POST /v1/agents/{your address}/owner-claim). Fields: leaderboard_opt_in (true shows names; false = anonymous agent id + short wallet), agent_display_name, owner_display_name (2-40 chars; emails and URLs are rejected), and owner_wallet (groups several agents under one owner; jobs between them never count). An owner's public name is set by the owner_wallet signing this for itself. Self-asserted; never required for jobs. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.

ai.agenlify/catalog.name: search_agents
ai.agenlify/catalog.description: Search the public Agenlify catalog by English or Chinese task, product name or official domain. Filter by pricing, setup, category, task and evidence. Returns dated catalog summaries and source links; empty results mean no documented match.

query.description: Task, product name or official website domain. Empty lists products.

evidence.description: checked: official-source review; tested: only products with a recorded case, not a general endorsement.

ai.agenlify/catalog.name: get_agent
ai.agenlify/catalog.description: Get a catalog product by exact slug, including inputs, outputs, setup steps, limitations, human review requirements, pricing review dates, official sources and any separately recorded case studies.

ai.agenlify/catalog.name: list_tasks
ai.agenlify/catalog.description: List Agenlify task IDs, preparation checklists, expected outputs and review requirements. Each listed task has at least three catalog candidates. Optionally filter tasks by category.

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: search_drinks
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: Find beers, wines, spirits, ciders and ready-to-drink drinks by name, style, origin or category across every open country node. Returns record ids with each record's CUVEE.

query.description: name, style, origin or category

category.description: optional category to keep: beer, wine, spirits, cider_perry or rtd (ready-to-drink)

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: get_record
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: Read one product in full by record_id: every field with its source page, reader and state; its CUVEE; its claim status; the signed record (JWS).

record_id.description: the record id, <node>:<6 digits>, e.g. es-bev:000123

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: find_producer
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: Find a maker and its products across every open node, with the maker's name as each source wrote it.

producer.description: the maker's name, or part of it

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: list_nodes
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: List the countries on the record: each node's door, languages, state and, for an open node, its counts.

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: compare_drinks
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: Compare two to ten products side by side, field by field, each value with its source page.

record_ids.description: two to ten record ids, e.g. ["es-bev:000123", "fr-bev:000456"]

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: get_order_route
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: Get the maker's or distributor's trade channel to order a product, as the record states it. Never a consumer channel.

record_id.description: the record id, <node>:<6 digits>, e.g. es-bev:000123

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: create_order_intent
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: Place an order intent for one to ten records (quantity, delivery market, optional date and note, the buyer's organisation and email). The Bourse routes it to each maker; verified makers answer with offers, and a maker's own Brand Agent address comes back with the routing. The email stays private: it is the buyer's key to read offers and accept one.

record_ids.description: one to ten record ids to order, e.g. ["es-bev:000123"]

quantity.description: quantity with its unit, e.g. 600 bottles (75 cl)

buyer.description: the buying organisation and its email (kept private; the key to read offers and accept one)

email.description: the buyer's email

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: get_offers
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: Read the makers' offers on an order intent, and the order once placed. By the buyer's email given on create_order_intent.

intent_id.description: the order intent id from create_order_intent, oi-<16 hex>

email.description: the buyer's email given on create_order_intent

ai.agent-bev/bev-door.name: accept_offer
ai.agent-bev/bev-door.description: Accept one offer and place the order through the Bourse. Accepting is one x402 paid call (HTTP 402 with the payment offer until paid): it settles and signs the order. The goods are paid between the two companies on the offer's own terms.

intent_id.description: the order intent id, oi-<16 hex>

offer_id.description: the offer to accept, as get_offers lists it

email.description: the buyer's email given on create_order_intent

ai.agent-bev/bevgtin.name: confirm_gtin
ai.agent-bev/bevgtin.description: Confirm one GTIN as a beverage alcohol product the trade will move: well-formed, seen (pages and dates), CUVEE category, strength, container, deposit, excise class, age-gated, markets and banners seen, signed. Unknown means no observation, never a guess.

gtin.description: The GTIN as printed: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits (spaces allowed)

market.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market (uk, de, fr …) to say whether the product was seen there

pay.description: Optional. true asks for the paid confirm: an x402 settlement on Base (HTTP 402 with the offer until PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is sent) and a signed receipt with the answer. Without it the confirm is open access.

ai.agent-bev/library.name: get_rulebook
ai.agent-bev/library.description: The trade rulebook for one country by its two-letter code (uk for the United Kingdom): market status, who can trade, customs and duty, labelling, age and sale limits, protected names, GTIN authority, and open items and as-of date; each section lists its official sources, and a part with no official source says "Not yet sourced".

code.description: two-letter country code as the Library writes it, for example es, uk, jp

ai.agent-bev/library.name: list_countries
ai.agent-bev/library.description: Every country in the Library with its code, its page and its as-of date.
