ai.bcited/bcited.name: scan_site
ai.bcited/bcited.description: Run b/cited's Site Readiness scan on one public URL: a rule-based audit (not model-judged) of 30+ observable signals across nine categories — indexing, metadata, social cards, structured data, AEO (llms.txt, ai.txt, AI-crawler stance in robots.txt, FAQPage/HowTo/Author schema), international, mobile, security headers, and performance. Returns an A–F grade, a 0–100 score per category, and every check with pass/warn/fail and a detail line. Performance (Core Web Vitals via PageSpeed Insights) is off by default because it adds up to 45 seconds; set include_performance to true to include it. Results are cached for an hour and shared across callers (source: "cache"). Private, loopback and .local hosts are rejected.

url.description: The public page to scan. A bare host like example.com is accepted; https is assumed.

include_performance.description: Also run Core Web Vitals via PageSpeed Insights. Slower (up to 45 s) and on a separate daily budget. Default false.

ai.bcited/bcited.name: list_leaderboard_categories
ai.bcited/bcited.description: List the 12 industry categories of b/cited's public AEO readiness leaderboard (slug, name, description).

ai.bcited/bcited.name: get_leaderboard
ai.bcited/bcited.description: Return one category of b/cited's public AEO readiness leaderboard: every curated domain ranked by overall readiness score (0–100) with its letter grade and AEO score, as scanned weekly by the same rule-based scanner as the site scan. Unscanned domains sort last with null scores.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. "crm" or "project-management".

limit.description: How many rows to return, from the top. Default 15 (a full category).

ai.bcited/bcited.name: get_domain_readiness
ai.bcited/bcited.description: Look up one domain on b/cited's public AEO readiness leaderboard: its rank, grade, overall and AEO scores in every category it appears in, the AEO-category checks from its most recent weekly scan, and its score history (newest first). Covers only the 180 curated leaderboard domains.

domain.description: Apex domain, e.g. "asana.com". A URL is accepted and reduced to its host.

category.description: Restrict to one category slug when the domain is listed in several.

history_limit.description: How many weekly history points to return. Default 12.

ai.bcited/bcited.name: get_prompt_citations
ai.bcited/bcited.description: For one leaderboard category, which sites ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity cited when asked b/cited's fixed set of buyer prompts, for one ISO week (default: the latest recorded). Per prompt and engine: the ordered cited hosts and whether each is on the board; per board domain: cited on N of M prompt-and-engine pairs and best rank; plus hosts cited that are not on the board. This is engine output at run time, not a scanner score; the prompts are a sample, not a census; no endorsement is implied.

category.description: Leaderboard category slug, e.g. "crm".

week.description: ISO week like "2026-W38". Default: the latest week with data.

ai.bcited/bcited.name: lookup_glossary
ai.bcited/bcited.description: Define a term the way b/cited's glossary defines it — AEO, citation, brand rank, visibility score, authority score, topical cluster, coverage diff, llms.txt, ai.txt, and 30 more. Matches on term, alias, or slug, and returns the best match plus close alternatives. With no term, returns every entry.

term.description: The term, alias, or slug to look up. Omit to list all entries.

ai.beevr/beevr.name: search_beevr
ai.beevr/beevr.description: Search BeevR services, shipped case studies and articles (AI agents, MVP cost, HIPAA/PCI compliance, offshore development in Vietnam). Returns ranked matches with URLs.

query.description: What you are looking for.

ai.beevr/beevr.name: get_pricing
ai.beevr/beevr.description: Get BeevR fixed-price packages (Pitch Demo, Investor MVP, Flagship Sprint) with price, duration and what is included.

ai.beevr/beevr.name: list_services
ai.beevr/beevr.description: List BeevR services (AI agent development, AI development, MVP development, HIPAA and fintech MVPs, custom software, offshore development in Vietnam) with summaries and URLs.

ai.beevr/beevr.name: list_case_studies
ai.beevr/beevr.description: List production systems BeevR has shipped (healthcare AI, security agent, AI B2B matchmaking, fintech payments, manufacturing) with key results and stack.

ai.beevr/beevr.name: get_case_study
ai.beevr/beevr.description: Get the full write-up of one BeevR case study as Markdown, by slug (from list_case_studies).

ai.beevr/beevr.name: list_articles
ai.beevr/beevr.description: List BeevR blog articles (newest first), optionally filtered by a keyword query.

ai.beevr/beevr.name: get_article
ai.beevr/beevr.description: Get one BeevR blog article as Markdown, by slug (from list_articles or search_beevr).

ai.beevr/beevr.name: about_beevr
ai.beevr/beevr.description: Who BeevR is, its AI capabilities (production agents, HIPAA AI, GraphRAG, Kite framework) and how to contact the team.

ai.beexcellent/reference.name: excellent_help
ai.beexcellent/reference.description: Excellent's own help text (the passages its in-app assistant answers from): how to do a task in Excellent — proposals, e-signed contracts, deposits and invoices, banquet event orders, floor plans, menus, staff training (Craft), marketing drafts, connecting an AI assistant. Returns up to 3 passages, best match first, each with the in-app page it starts on. No account needed; it reads no restaurant group's data.

query.description: What to look up, in plain words (e.g. "deposit schedule", "banquet event order", "Tripleseat").

ai.beexcellent/reference.name: search_excellent_pages
ai.beexcellent/reference.description: Search Excellent's published pages: feature pages (what each part of the product does), comparison pages (Excellent vs another events or private-dining platform, with where each one wins and the date the comparison was last reviewed), the blog, and guides (how to connect Claude, with 15 things to ask it). Returns up to 5 pages with their URL and the page's own summary text. No account needed.

query.description: What to look up, in plain words (e.g. "deposit schedule", "banquet event order", "Tripleseat").

kind.description: Optional: only one kind of page.

ai.beexcellent/reference.name: find_event_venues
ai.beexcellent/reference.description: Finds restaurants and venues on Excellent that accept private-event and group-dining inquiries from AI assistants, by the restaurant group's or the venue's name. Returns up to 10, each with the group, the venue, who replies, a handle for send_event_inquiry and the venue's public inquiry page. Only venues that opted in are listed, and only what their public inquiry page shows. No account needed.

query.description: The restaurant group's or venue's name, e.g. "Lumière" or "Harbor Room".

ai.beexcellent/reference.name: start_excellent_workspace
ai.beexcellent/reference.description: Creates a new Excellent workspace filled with sample data (a fictional restaurant group with two venues, bookings, proposals, invoices, staff training and marketing drafts) and returns a one-time link for the person you are helping. Opening the link while signed in to Excellent, or after creating a login there, makes the workspace theirs. Nobody can use it before then, and an unclaimed workspace is deleted when its link expires after 7 days. Takes no arguments and no personal data. At most 3 a day per address.

ai.beexcellent/reference.name: send_event_inquiry
ai.beexcellent/reference.description: Sends a private-event or group-dining inquiry, on behalf of the person you are helping, to a venue that accepts inquiries from AI assistants (its handle comes from find_event_venues). Use it only when the person asked you to contact the venue, with the details they gave you. It lands in the venue's inbox as a new lead for the venue's team to review and answer directly; it books, holds and pays for nothing, and Excellent sends the guest no email. Give an email or a phone so the venue can reply. Answers only whether it was filed. At most 5 an hour and 20 a day per address.

venue.description: The venue's handle from find_event_venues (org/form), or its inquiry_url.

guest_name.description: The guest's name, as they gave it.

guest_email.description: The guest's email, for the venue's reply. Give this or guest_phone.

guest_phone.description: The guest's phone, for the venue's reply. Give this or guest_email.

event_type.description: Optional: the occasion, e.g. "birthday dinner", "rehearsal dinner", "team offsite".

event_date.description: Optional: the date they want, YYYY-MM-DD.

message.description: Optional: anything else they want the venue to know, in their words.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_brief
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Read a cited research brief for a covered U.S. ticker, ETF or released subject. Overview, current and full views support dated research and historical cutoffs. An explicit refresh requires current stock and SPY prices before payment. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

refresh_market_data.description: Current briefs serve prepared research and refresh a missing or stale requested-stock quote by default. Set false to retain stored quotes. Daily paths and benchmark context refresh during preparation. Historical reads never refresh.

max_results.description: Maximum returned views. Overview returns at most five (default five); larger valid requests are capped at five with explicit returned and omitted counts. Full supports 1–20. Omit for an ordinary overview.

detail.description: Issuer_evidence lists retained SEC filing captures. To inspect a document, reuse its as_of with issuer_document_id and a literal issuer_query; continue with issuer_match_offset. This is a stored, metered evidence read without collection or model calls. Current returns up to three reviewed current Beliefs with up to three Risks and three Catalysts each, direct evidence URLs, clocks and explicit unknowns under 32KiB. Attached open Risks or materialized Risks with supported continuing relevance qualify, without age/severity exclusion; unknown concerns remain separately qualified. Selection reserves opposing views, then distinct stances, effective/publication recency, observed recency and stable ID. Omitted whole cases have continuations/detail references. Current is a stored read and cannot refresh. Start with overview for research questions: it includes complete selected cases, dated developments, assessment and citations. Full is for a complete machine export; oversized full company reads through MCP return an explicitly bounded overview with case IDs for get_case drill-down. REST detail=full retains the export. Fund briefs return fund_overview for either value.

entity_id.description: Released subject ID returned by get_subjects.

issuer_document_id.description: For detail=issuer_evidence, select a document_id returned by its inventory; also pass the returned as_of and a literal issuer_query.

issuer_query.description: Literal phrase to find across one complete retained SEC document. Returns up to five cited excerpts, including beyond cached text prefixes; no raw document export.

issuer_match_offset.description: Continue with next_match_offset and unchanged ticker, as_of, issuer_document_id and issuer_query. Each read uses normal research allowance or credit.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_case
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves one complete investment case by returned belief_id: investor, reasoning, evidence, risks, catalysts, conditions, revisions, outcomes, provenance and coverage gaps. Useful for deeper follow-ups; start company overviews with get_brief. Use paragraph_index only when returned in investment_case and follow support/text offsets for exact evidence. Optional relationship_paths inspects supported dependencies; scenario applies up to eight hypothetical conditions. Both preserve evidence and investor statements. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

paragraph_index.description: Read exact source support only for a paragraph_index present in the returned investment_case. Records without investment_case do not support this selector. Requires belief_id. Continue with returned as_of and support/text offsets.

support_index.description: Source support within the selected paragraph; defaults to 0. Use next_support_index for another passage.

support_text_offset.description: UTF-16 offset within the selected supporting passage; defaults to 0. Use next_text_offset to continue its text.

scenario.description: Optional hypothetical condition assumptions for this belief. Does not change evidence or predict the investor's response. REST: JSON-encode this query parameter.

relationship_paths.description: Inspect directed edge sequences within this Belief's originating case. Maximum depth is 3; edge_budget bounds examined edge steps. Requires belief_id. REST: JSON-encode relationship_paths.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_cases
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves dated investment cases for one company or research subject, with optional investor, direction and time filters. Returns attributed thesis records, case IDs, dates, citations and coverage information. Use get_brief first for who covers a ticker and what each investor thinks. Use get_cases for an article-by-article inventory. Each page costs a request. Continue only if the user wants more pages, using unchanged selectors and the returned cursor. Use get_search_results for a thesis or topic question. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

entity_id.description: Released subject ID returned by get_subjects.

changed_since.description: Find initial research, author revisions, condition checks/plans or released outcomes becoming available after this cutoff. Keeps author dates and stance separate from system activity. Release changes and a complete ordered event-history checkpoint are not yet included.

limit.description: Requested page size. For ticker/entity belief lists, MCP returns up to twelve complete summaries within its response budget; pagination.limit is the effective size. Continue with next_cursor and the same ticker/entity_id. REST supports larger pages.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_catalysts
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves evidence-linked catalysts for one company, research subject, investment case or the explicitly selected released corpus. Returns recorded conditions, lifecycle status, dates and supporting evidence. Useful for checking which thesis events remain pending, were met or missed, or have been superseded. Filter by investor, source, publication dates or status. Unassessed conditions retain unknown status. Continue with the returned cursor and unchanged filters. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_changes
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves the ordered research change journal for a company, subject, case or explicitly selected released corpus. Returns dated events, citations and available before/after values, separating author revisions, distribution changes and calculated publication outcomes. Use domain=author_view for investor-view changes and revision_only=true for authored revisions only; get_brief provides a current synthesis. Preserve publication, observation and availability clocks. Drain a requested window with unchanged selectors; its continuation cursor differs from the completed next-poll checkpoint. Coverage and resynchronization gaps remain explicit. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_companies
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Find SEC-registered U.S. companies and selected verified international listings by symbol or name. Search by market, sector or exchange-qualified symbol, such as Indian banks, Canadian stocks or XTAI:2330. Listing identity and released investor research are reported separately. Free.

q.description: Search the current SEC company directory by ticker or name, independently of direct research coverage. Omit as_of.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_company_facts
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Returns retained financial facts, company references, segment metrics, operating KPIs, management guidance and site milestones for one ticker. Use record_type=site_milestone for cited permit, contract, delivery and billing stages and source-specific dates. Use fiscal_year/fiscal_quarter for fiscal periods and date_field=report for issuance. Guidance is a forecast; reported tolerances and computed bounds stay separate. Inspect available_issuer_selectors for empty metric or dimension results. Coverage is bounded. Current archive reads recheck stale metadata. Historical and pinned reads use saved records. Reuse snapshot, cutoff and filters with the returned cursor or next_offset. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

cursor.description: Archive continuation token; reuse with snapshot ID/hash, as_of and unchanged filters.

as_of.description: Availability cutoff, separate from event/period filters. Historical reads never refresh.

snapshot_id.description: Pin continuation to the returned snapshot ID; reuse with snapshot_hash and as_of.

filters_sha256.description: Reuse the returned filter hash unchanged with continuation pages.

limit.description: Matching typed observations per page; default32.

max_snapshot_age_hours.description: Requested verification-age tolerance: default1hour for retained archives,24hours for closing-price references. Record dates and publication cadence are separate.

date_from.description: Inclusive native date lower bound, selected by date_field.

date_to.description: Inclusive native date upper bound, selected by date_field.

date_field.description: Date meaning; defaults to period for facts/macro/holdings/returns, event for insider trades, observation for options/short volume, scheduled for calendar.

period_start.description: Exact reported fact period start; distinguish quarterly and annual facts with the same end date.

record_type.description: Select financial_fact, financial_statement, company_reference, segment_metric, operating_kpi, management_guidance or site_milestone. Site milestones keep permit, contract, delivery, billing and plan stages distinct. Issuer metrics use selected admitted SEC disclosures, not complete history; guidance is a forecast, not an actual result.

power_stage.description: Match the site milestone or its power measurements at this stage. Requires site_milestone.

basis.description: Accounting or operating basis; requires an issuer-metric record_type.

dimension.description: Issuer-reported segment, product or geography label substring; requires an issuer-metric record_type.

period_label.description: Exact returned fiscal period label; requires an issuer-metric record_type. Use for guidance targets whose calendar dates are unknown; date_field=report instead filters issuance dates.

fiscal_year.description: Issuer's stated fiscal year; requires an issuer-metric record_type. Does not imply calendar-year dates.

fiscal_quarter.description: Issuer's stated fiscal quarter, 1 through 4; use with fiscal_year for requested fiscal periods.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_comparison
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves a cited engine comparison of two distinct investment cases using their returned belief_id and compare_to_belief_id. Returns a cited engine assessment of support, contradiction, dependency, unknown or unrelated reasoning, with assessment time and case cutoff. Useful for examining opposing views or investment alternatives. Optional comparison_focus narrows the assessment to a public research proposition present in both cases. Engine assessments remain separate from investor statements; shared sources qualify the independence of support. Per-call x402 price: 0.50 USDC on Base.

comparison_focus.description: Optional public research topic or proposition to compare within both complete cases. Supply a topic, not a desired relation, private portfolio information or instructions. Other relations in the cases are outside this focused assessment.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_context_assessment
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves a dated engine context assessment by its returned assessment identifier, including permitted supporting evidence and coverage limitations. Useful for examining the issuer, market or event context cited in a brief or investment case. Assessment time and evidence dates remain explicit; the engine's interpretation is separate from the investor's stated thesis. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_economic_calendar
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves retained US economic events in one ticker research scope. Filter by event text, region, scheduled/reported/unconfirmed state and scheduled-date bounds. Returns typed actual, previous, consensus and forecast literals, revision markers, native times and source support; an unverified timezone stays unknown. Current requests recheck stale mirror metadata; historical and pinned reads never refresh. This is retained calendar context, with snapshot freshness separate from event time. Continue with the returned snapshot, cutoff, filters and cursor or next_offset. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_insider_trades
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves source-reported insider transactions for one ticker. Filter by reporting owner name or CIK, transaction codes, derivative status and transaction or filing dates. Returns typed owners, security units, prices, acquisition/disposition codes, filing dates and exact support; SEC codes distinguish market purchases/sales (P/S), gifts (G), tax withholding (F) and exercises (M). Owner names use reported SEC spelling; resolve ambiguous or unfamiliar aliases from returned owners. Current requests recheck stale retained mirror metadata; historical and pinned reads remain fixed. Use returned snapshot and cursor or next_offset for further pages; coverage and held records remain explicit. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_institutional_holdings
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves reported institutional holdings for one ticker across supported retained 13F history. Filter by manager name or CIK, report period, filing dates, amendments, share class and shares versus PUT/CALL positions. Returns typed quantities, native reported values, manager identities and source support. Identifier and filing-join checks hold ambiguous records; report dates differ from filing dates, and native value scales remain explicit. Current requests recheck stale mirror metadata; historical/pinned reads never switch snapshots. Continue with the returned snapshot ID/hash, as_of, filters and cursor or next_offset. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_investor_outcomes
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves an investor's stored publication-based outcomes for one company, research subject, investment case or the explicitly selected released corpus. Returns action, entry-price and horizon cohorts, verified exits, losses, pending results and ineligible counts. Useful for reviewing measured thesis outcomes and their sample limitations. Filter by source and publication window; narrow a scope that exceeds the returned bound. Uses stored market observations, with historical source completeness explicitly unknown. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

ai.beliefstate/investor-research.name: get_macro_context
ai.beliefstate/investor-research.description: Retrieves retained government macroeconomic observations in one ticker research scope. Filter by native series_ids, agency, measurement_names and period dates; returns typed values, units, seasonal bases, scales, native periods and source support. Supported archive formats cover Treasury, NY Fed, BLS, BEA, EIA, CFTC and metadata-qualified Federal Reserve Board series; other admitted context is explicitly bounded. Macro backdrop does not establish company exposure or a historical data vintage; FRED and rights-held series are unavailable. Current requests recheck stale mirror metadata; historical/pinned reads remain fixed. Continue with the returned snapshot, cutoff, filters and cursor or next_offset. Per-call x402 price: 0.02 USDC on Base.

ai.benroberts/b4-index.name: b4_browse
ai.benroberts/b4-index.description: For browsing, filtering, or finding the index's name for something. Example: {"query": "warehouse picking", "domain": "Supply Chain"}. Search and filter every independently scored software category in the B4 Index. Browse by keyword, domain, quadrant, or industry. When filtering by industry, returns all vertical categories for that industry PLUS all horizontal categories (which apply to every industry). Each row carries its banded verdict — primary, confidence word, and a near-call flag — and the quadrant filter matches the verdict at whichever lens you are reading. Verdicts are banded (B4 methodology v4.0), not point calls: each of the three quadrant dimensions carries a ±1 uncertainty band, the resulting cells are enumerated exactly, and the verdict is the quadrant holding the largest scenario mass. Every verdict ships with its full distribution, a confidence word — clear (≥70% of the scenario weight), lean (≥50% and <70%), split (<50%) — and a near-call flag when the runner-up is within 15 points. An axis counts as high only when it clears the 3.5 line strictly, which on this 1–5 grid means only at 4 or above, so a category sitting exactly on the line gets the safer call: ties break in the order BUY → BRIDGE → BEWARE → BUILD, cheapest mistake first. Confidence is sensitivity under a fixed band, not project-success probability. Optional org lens: set org to "small", "medium" (the default) or "large" to read the same scores as a team of that engineering maturity — it shifts the center of the AI-feasibility band by −1 / 0 / +1 and nothing else. The lens is a filter the caller looks through, never a stored profile. Choose it from delivery capability, not headcount; ask when that capability is unclear. The raw scores themselves never change. Omit it and you get the default-lens numbers, which are the ones published on logged-out surfaces. Routing: a vendor or product name → b4_audit (one or many; add a short description of what it does for anything the index may not know); a need or problem in words → b4_recommend; an exact category name or id → b4_score (one category) or b4_compare (build vs buy paths); browsing, filtering, or an unknown vocabulary → b4_browse. When an audit row returns clarification.needed, relay askTheUser to the user and re-run that row with the answer as its description. [Needs a B4 plan: browse and score come with B4 Web.]

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_todays_board
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: The app Live board (GET live/board): upcoming and in-play games, each with mainLines: its DraftKings game lines (slot, line, odds), optional league or sport, limit 1-20 and cursor. sport reads a sport chip's board across its leagues (SPRT_tennis, SPRT_soccer, SPRT_golf; tennis and golf games have no league). A league outside the app's chips is built on its first read, so that first answer can be 503 provider_unavailable with retryAfterSeconds: read again in about 60 s. Only leagues in season with a DraftKings price right now are listed: a league or sport without one answers no games (it is not in get_league_order either) and comes back by itself once its games are priced. mode: live with includeStatus: true lists only the games in play now, each with its status (a game in a league with no scoreboard feed, such as tennis or UFC, is listed while DraftKings prices it in play: its status is in_progress with the score, period and clock a public scoreboard has for it, or none; tennis: score = sets won, period = the set in play, displayClock = that set's games home-away; UFC: period = round); with includeStatus: true, eventSeries gives each game its playoff series line (round, game, summary; MLB now) or null; stale: true means some games could not be confirmed yet, so read again shortly. Use category: event_catalog for original event market identities, event_prices for an exact source-bound group at one book, or board_snapshot for one prewarmed page; those require request. pickem is the app's Pick'Em board for one game: request {eventId} returns the catalogue page and pickem.markets (full-game player Over/Under); request {eventId, marketId} returns that market's lines with DraftKings' price on each (pickem.prices). Never a wager.

view.description: Optional; the app board is the only view.

category.description: Source-bound categories require request; board_snapshot reads one complete prewarmed page without provider work; games uses the board filters.

request.description: Required for event_catalog, event_prices or board_snapshot. Pass the exact original source-bound request; never relabel source IDs or periods.

sport.description: A sport chip board instead of league, e.g. SPRT_tennis.

mode.description: Games in play now; needs includeStatus: true.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: grade_slip
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Combined form of quote_grade, start_grade and cancel_grade (same fields, same answers): version bsd-agent-grade-v1, action quote, start or cancel, and a commandKey. Paid plans can run Fast, Pro (wire depth deep) or Elite at the quoted price. If the Grade returns no letter, the units come back. Show the quote before a start; send force: true on quote only when the customer wants a new Grade of an already graded slip. Text and legacy SGP inputs return migration_required.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_saved_reports
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the saved Grade jobs and reports behind list_grade_jobs, get_grade_job, get_grade_progress, get_grade_groups, get_grade_report, get_grade_evidence and get_grade_catalog. This combined tool requires version bsd-agent-grade-v1 and action list, job, progress, groups, report, evidence or catalog; the individual tools omit version and action.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_history_summary
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: The authenticated account's app History summary (GET history/summary): record, stake and net over the chosen range, with its source, currency and limitation rules. Numbers come only from the account's own records; nothing is fabricated. category reads the other History pages the app shows.

view.description: Optional; the app History is the only view.

range.description: 1y is a rolling calendar year; ytd is year to date.

category.description: Current app History read (the app route body). report_advice takes reportId and reads its state and digest without recording a display. Context takes original recordId and recordKind; advice also requires the original record references and returns Grade letters.

request.description: Use the existing History filters/cursor for this category. Advice before placement is distinct from current or retrospective responses.

recordId.description: Original owned History record ID (advice, context, record, recall_record, record_doctor_decisions).

id.description: earlier_report: the saved report; links: the import.

params.description: The app query for chart, record_doctor_decisions, earlier_reports, recall (filters as JSON text), recall_week, grade_comparison, doctor_overview and imports.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: price_shop_slip
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Compare books on a saved slip, exactly the app's Compare books (POST tickets/compare-books): each leg's current price at up to 5 books (books: book ids; default the slip's own book, DraftKings and FanDuel), the best price for the bettor and how much the slip's own price gives up (lineShop). comparison is the app answer unchanged. Save the slip first (track_slip, ticket_actions save_live, scan_slip). Every paid plan, as the app; a free account gets { locked: true, betterPriceExists } only (no book or price). Never places a wager.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: doctor_conversation
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read or change a Doctor conversation with version bsd-agent-doctor-v1 and an action; the individual Doctor tools omit version and action. For quote send {version: "bsd-agent-doctor-v1", action: "quote", commandKey, threadId, sequence, text}: commandKey is a new 16–120 character letters/digits/underscore/hyphen key, reused on retry; threadId is the owned thread UUID; sequence is its current integer sequence (read action conversation); text is the question. Optional responseStyle applies only to this reply. Optional doctorType fast/pro/elite picks the Fast, Pro or Elite Doctor for this reply; omit for the plan’s own Doctor. Show the quote and get the customer’s yes, then start with {version: "bsd-agent-doctor-v1", action: "start", commandKey: a new key, quoteId: the quote id}. Remember or forget a note only when explicitly asked. Read the saved result before relaying an answer.

commandKey.description: Stable key for one write action and all its retries.

responseStyle.description: This reply only. Omit to preserve the account default.

doctorType.description: This reply only: the Fast, Pro (recommended) or Elite Doctor. Omit for the plan’s own Doctor. Free plans have the Fast Doctor only.

id.description: Exact owned note ID to remove.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: tail_read
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read Tail with version bsd-agent-tail-v1 and an action. Use doctor_record with profileId for the Doctor’s all-time record. The individual tools get_doctor_picks, get_doctor_parlays, get_crowd_parlay, get_league_order, get_tail_feed, tail_hot, tail_my_posts and get_tail_post omit version and action. More Tail reads on their app routes: vip_feed: GET vip/feed params {sellerId (required), cursor, limit 1-25}; subscriber feed for this account; vip_state: GET vip/state this account’s VIP subscriptions and seller state; community: GET community/tail params {limit, cursor, search, profile}; showcase: GET community/tail/showcase; showcase_posts: GET community/tail/showcase/posts params {ids}; verified_cappers: GET tail/verified-cappers; timeline: GET tail/timeline params {limit, cursor}; timeline_post: GET tail/timeline/posts/{postId}; own_profile: GET tail/profile; profiles: GET tail/profiles params {prefix, limit, cursor}; profile: GET tail/profiles/{profileId}; profile_record: GET tail/profiles/{profileId}/record; profile_record_v2: GET tail/profiles/{profileId}/record-v2 Public record: lead with netUnits when known, then win percentage and W-L-P; unknown units remain unavailable; profile_connections: GET tail/profiles/{profileId}/connections params {direction followers|following, limit, cursor}; relations: GET tail/relations params {kind follow|mute|block, limit, cursor}; search: POST tail/search params {query, category people|posts, limit, cursor}; lists: GET tail/lists params {limit, cursor}; list: GET tail/lists/{listId}; list_members: GET tail/lists/{listId}/members params {limit, cursor}; replies: GET tail/posts/{postId}/replies params {limit, cursor}; reply: GET tail/replies/{replyId}; moments: GET tail/moments params as the app; top: GET tail/top params as the app; top_v2: GET tail/top-v2 params {limit 1-50}; repost_state: GET tail/posts/{postId}/repost; post_grade: GET tail/posts/{postId}/grade; post_analysis: GET tail/posts/{postId}/analysis.

league.description: doctor_parlays (required) and doctor_picks (optional filter): one league id, e.g. LGUE_nfl.

sport.description: doctor_picks only (optional filter): one sport id, e.g. SPRT_americanfootball.

gradeFamily.description: feed and hot: only posts whose letter is in this family.

params.description: The app query (or tail/search body) for vip_feed (sellerId required, cursor, limit 1-25), community, showcase_posts, timeline, profiles, profile_connections, relations, search, lists, list_members, replies, moments, top, top_v2.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: tail_post
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Preview or change Tail with version bsd-agent-tail-v1 and an action; the individual Tail tools omit version and action. Make changes only when the customer asks. Publish only after showing the exact preview and getting their yes; publishing never places a wager.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: grade_pickem_entry
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Use action settlement with ticketId to read this owned entry’s result (history.read also required). Use bsd-pickem-grade-v2. check returns per-pick availability without research or a model call; letters are not scored yet. quote saves the owned Power or complete Flex child-ticket structure. Whole-entry Grade stays unavailable without confirmed book payouts and supported engine shape. start never bypasses those requirements. report also requires reports.read. No wager is placed.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: quote_grade
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Quote a Grade for an owned saved ticketId or one confirmed manual ticket (which it may save), at the requested depth and optional funding. Returns the app’s allowance quote and starts nothing: show it before start_grade. A slip already graded answers existing_grade (its jobId and report) or grade_in_progress: open that report with get_saved_reports; send force true only when the customer wants a new Grade. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: start_grade
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Start the owned Grade quoteId after the customer has seen and accepted its allowance quote. Reserves app allowance and queues the same durable Grade job; consent, tier, plan usage and admission rules apply. Optional doctorThreadId: the owned Doctor conversation whose parlay this is; its finished letter posts into that conversation, as in the app. Returns a job, not a completed answer. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: cancel_grade
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Cancel an owned Grade jobId through the app service. Stops eligible work and releases its remaining reservation under the existing app rules; cannot undo provider work already performed. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: list_grade_jobs
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the authenticated account’s current Grade library, with optional limit 1-20 and account-bound cursor. Each row’s headline is its Rocky letter and report.rockyGradeSummary its label and score. When letterFine is present, show it; otherwise show letter. Never starts research.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_grade_job
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the owned Grade jobId and its current durable status. Never starts or resumes work.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_grade_progress
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read saved progress for the owned Grade jobId, with optional after sequence and limit 1-100. Progress is not proof that a saved report is ready; never starts work.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_grade_catalog
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read this account’s Grade research options and available capabilities, including in-play eligibility when enabled. Does not start a Grade.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_grade_groups
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the owned Grade job’s group scores as they become available. Status is pending, partial or final; partial scores can change and are not a saved final report. Does not start work.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_grade_report
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Return the verified saved report for a completed Grade this account owns, by jobId. Returns unavailable until the saved report is readable; never grades again. headline carries the saved coarse letter and, for newer Grades, letterFine; show letterFine when present, otherwise letter. rockySummary carries each leg’s modeled win chance against its break-even and its EV, the chance all legs win, confidence, top risks and the NG reasons (chances and EV as fractions), and view: Research and Price, each a level (Strong, OK or Weak, or null when it couldn’t be checked) with a plain reason; what moved the Grade, by name; on Grades saved before 2026-11-05, the cap line when a better price capped the letter; and the checks that couldn’t run. The same breakdown the app shows. On Grades made under the one-number rule, rockySummary.oneNumber says where the letter started (startLetter; each leg’s start chance and whether it is the Desk’s number or the same-line price) and lists the evidence that moved it: what happened, helps or hurts, how many points of chance, the source link and the exact sentence quoted from it; line is the biggest item as one sentence, or, when nothing moved the letter, a quoted context sentence that says it is context and claims no points (else null).

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_grade_evidence
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Return the evidence behind an owned completed Grade jobId: each claim checked (price, injury and lineup, matchup, form, line move, situational, weather, correlation), its sources with tier 1-5, age and supports/contradicts tag, unknowns, and whether it was verified. Never grades again.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: open_doctor_conversation
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Persist an app Doctor thread, optionally attached to an owned ticket, report or history item. Does not start a reply or spend a consult allowance. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: list_doctor_conversations
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read this account’s saved app Doctor threads. Does not generate an answer.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_doctor_conversation
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the owned threadId, saved user messages, Doctor answers and jobs; optional before pages older messages. Does not generate a new answer.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_doctor_quota
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read this account’s current app consult allowance, held and used amounts, and reset information. Does not reserve a consult.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_bettor_profile
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read this authenticated account’s bettor model, optionally filtered by topic: confirmed notes and revisions, separately attributed Honcho inferred context, source IDs when supplied, generation, recall state and as-of. Unavailable inference stays unavailable. Memory and AI consent apply; recalled statements never establish bet outcomes or change Grade math. For a public Tail record use tail_read profile_record_v2 (or get_capper_record when available), leading with net units.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_doctor_memory
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read this authenticated account’s confirmed notes, active status, current revisions and memory generation. Longer-term Honcho personalization is recalled inside consults. These notes are user-reported preferences and lessons, not authoritative betting outcomes.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: remember_doctor_note
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Save only a preference, goal, constraint or context note the customer explicitly asked Doctor to remember. Corrections require the exact owned note id and expectedRevision from get_doctor_memory. note.confirmation must be save_for_future_consults. Do not silently infer mastery or save sporting results; those belong in saved betting records. A committed edit rotates inferred memory so a superseded note does not return. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: forget_doctor_note
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Remove the exact owned note only after the customer explicitly asks to forget it. Requires current id/expectedRevision and confirmation forget_for_future_consults. Rotates inferred memory under the existing account service; saved conversations remain separately retained until deleted. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: quote_doctor_reply
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Send commandKey (a new 16–120 character letters/digits/underscore/hyphen key), owned threadId UUID, current integer sequence from get_doctor_conversation, and text. Optional responseStyle learning/technical/roast applies to this reply; omit for the account default. Optional doctorType fast/pro/elite picks the Fast, Pro or Elite Doctor; omit for the plan’s own Doctor. Returns the allowance quote and the chosen doctorType without starting a reply. Show the quote before requesting a start. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

doctorType.description: Which Doctor answers this reply: fast = Fast Doctor (quick answers), pro = Pro Doctor (sharper reads for most questions, recommended), elite = Elite Doctor (the sharpest Doctor for the hardest slips). Omit for the plan's own Doctor. Free plans have the Fast Doctor only; a Doctor the plan does not include is refused with subscription_required, never swapped. Smarter Doctors take a little longer and use the plan faster.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: send_doctor_with_slip
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: For an explicit customer Send, pass exact pendingSlip selections and confirmation SEND. Reserves the existing allowance and returns the durable thread, quote and job promptly. The server confirms current prices and open legs before using the slip. A changed or closed price fails safely and returns the hold. No wager or Grade is started. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

doctorType.description: Which Doctor answers this reply: fast = Fast Doctor (quick answers), pro = Pro Doctor (sharper reads for most questions, recommended), elite = Elite Doctor (the sharpest Doctor for the hardest slips). Omit for the plan's own Doctor. Free plans have the Fast Doctor only; a Doctor the plan does not include is refused with subscription_required, never swapped. Smarter Doctors take a little longer and use the plan faster.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: cancel_doctor_send
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Stop an explicit pending send using its original sendKey commandKey, including before its job ID was received. Tombstones late starts and cancels any accepted job through the ordinary refund path. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: start_doctor_reply
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Start the owned consult quoteId after the customer has seen and accepted the quote. Reserves app allowance and queues the existing Doctor job; app AI consent, tier, plan usage, cost cap and admission rules apply. Does not return an answer before it is saved. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_doctor_job
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the owned Doctor jobId, including its real saved answer when available: paragraphs, the linked pages it cites (sources) and what it checked (checked: odds, scores, stats, news, the slip). Never generates or restarts a reply.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_doctor_events
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read saved events for the owned Doctor jobId, optionally after a sequence. While a reply is written, doctor_research_progress events say how many sources the Doctor is checking and which (stage checking, then writing). Never starts a consult.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: cancel_doctor_reply
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Cancel an owned Doctor jobId under the app cancellation and reservation rules. Cannot undo a reply or provider work already completed. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_doctor_parlays
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the Doctor’s posted parlays for one league (e.g. LGUE_nfl): 2-3 legs on different games, each B+ or better when posted. Upcoming first with the newest regrade (currentGrade), then recent WON/LOST/PUSH results and the parlays record. Items carry parlayType (lock = 2 legs, moonshot = 3), title, pitch, legCount, oddsAmerican (combined price) and netUnits once settled. Empty means nothing cleared the bar today. App permissions and paid-leg lock apply; a paid reader gets the legs to put the parlay on a slip.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_crowd_parlay
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the crowd parlay (the app’s Heat Check card): the one parlay bettors are on most right now, built in code, 2 to 4 legs on different games at one book, every game still to start, graded by the real Grade whatever the letter is (A to F). It is the crowd’s parlay, not the Doctor’s pick: it is never a Tail post and never on the Doctor’s record (onRecord false). parlay is null when fewer than two picks qualify, a game has started, or it is turned off. Each leg has pick, market, line, oddsAmerican, event, startsAt and heat: distinct people on that pick in the last 24 hours (accounts with it in a synced sportsbook bet or with a finished Grade of a slip carrying it; never who, and a pick needs 3). heat.bettors is distinct people on any of the legs, each person once. locked true (no Doctor’s Picks access) leaves legs null. To put it on the slip, send each leg’s selectionId as marketSelectionId with its eventId, the parlay bookId, line and oddsAmerican to check_slip. Never places a wager.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_league_order
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read BetSlip Doctor’s league order right now: the same leagues in the same order as the app’s league strip (its Home and Odds chips: games in play first, then the soonest tip within 6 hours, then games in the next 24 hours); Tennis, Soccer and Golf are sport chips and carry their SPRT_ id. Each row has rank, weight and phase (this week’s popularity times season phase), inSeason and featured. `slate` carries the default league and the featured game and the best qualifying Doctor hero (`doctorHero`), or null when none qualifies. For every reader the hero carries `title`: kind (single, parlay, sgp or singles), legCount and events (eventId, away, home, leagueId, startTime), never the pick; a paid reader also gets `post` and `slip` (bookId and each leg’s marketSelectionId, eventId, line, oddsAmerican). Put the hero on the slip with add_doctor_parlay_to_slip and its key. Lists only leagues in season with a DraftKings price right now (the same leagues as the app’s chips, search and league lists); a league leaves when it has no priced game and comes back by itself when it does. Read-only; no account data.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_doctor_picks
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read today’s saved Doctor picks and recent settled WON/LOST/PUSH results. Each item carries league (first leg’s league id), sport (first leg’s sport id) and leagues (every leg’s league), the same fields the app’s league tabs filter by, for every reader. Optional league (e.g. LGUE_nfl) and/or sport (e.g. SPRT_americanfootball) keep only matching items. Uses the app’s account permissions and paid-leg lock; no generation or current-price claim.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_tail_feed
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Doctor ticket posts include result WON/LOST/PUSH when settled, null otherwise. Read the app Tail feed with its account-filtered community, following, own, profile, bookmark or private-list visibility. Uses app moderation, mutes and account-bound cursor rules; does not post.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: add_doctor_parlay_to_slip
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Put one of the Doctor’s posted parlays (key from get_doctor_parlays) or the Home hero pick (get_league_order slate.doctorHero.key: a single, parlay or same-game parlay) on this account’s slip in one step, with a unique commandKey. Checks every leg’s current price at the parlay’s book, saves the parlay as a private unplaced ticket and returns its legs (marketSelectionId, oddsAmerican, line, eventId) and ticketId; counts one tail per account per parlay. Run check_slip with the ticketId before Grade or the book link. Same paid-leg lock as get_doctor_parlays; never places a bet. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: tail_react
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Add (active true) or remove (active false) this account’s fire reaction on a Tail postId, with a unique commandKey. One fire per account per post; fire feeds Hot picks. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: save_tail_post
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Save (active true) or unsave (active false) a Tail postId for this account, with a unique commandKey: the app’s Save on a post and on another bettor’s Tail Grade report. Private to this account; read saved posts with get_tail_feed feed bookmarks. Never places a wager. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: share_graded_ticket_to_tail
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Share an owned saved Grade report to Tail with nothing to type. Call with reportId and omit confirmation to get the exact preview and previewBinding: show it to the customer. After their explicit yes, call again with confirmation PUBLISH_POST, commandKey and that previewBinding (fWarning when the preview requires it). Set shareBreakdown true on both calls to also share the Grade breakdown; the preview then shows what readers get (gradeBreakdown for a current Grade). A valid confirmed call publishes; never places a wager. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: tail_my_posts
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read this account’s own Tail posts (newest first, cursor paging) with its record setting and post count (recordSettings: showRecord, postCount). Does not post.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: set_synced_record_consent
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Turn on (consent true) or off (default) the use of this account’s connected-sportsbook bets on its public record, with a unique commandKey. On: posted picks settle from the connected sportsbook, and the results and units show on the profile, posts and the Top list. Off: posts settle from final scores or the account’s own marks only. Separate from Show my record. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: set_show_my_record
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Turn “Show my record” on (default) or off with show true/false and a unique commandKey. Off hides the W-L, units and ROI from everyone but the account owner (zero record on posts, out of Top lists); posts stay public. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: tail_hot
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read Hot picks: open Tail tickets (not settled, at least one game not started) from the last 24 hours, ranked by heat: fire reactions, tails, fades and how many graded slips and synced sportsbook bets carry the same open leg (anonymous counts only, at least 3 before a count is used, never who), recency-weighted; the Doctor’s current pick pinned first. A ticket with no heat is not listed; when nothing is hot, ranking reads bsd-hot-rank-v2-best-graded and the items are the best-graded open tickets, newest first within a letter; when no ticket is open at all, ranking reads bsd-hot-rank-v2-recent and the items are the most recent tickets (last 24 hours, else the latest 10), already started or settled. Optional gradeFamily A-F filters by letter. Same visibility, moderation and mutes as the app; does not post.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_tail_post
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Doctor ticket posts include result WON/LOST/PUSH when settled, null otherwise. Read one app Tail postId visible to this account under the same moderation and privacy rules. Supply fadedByLimit (1-25) or fadedByCursor to include the permitted public confirmed-Fade profile page. May contain another community member’s published content; does not post.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: preview_tail_post
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Compute the exact app sharing preview and binding from an owned saved Grade report or Doctor exchange draft. Does not publish. Show the returned preview to the customer before requesting publication.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: publish_tail_post
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Submit the exact customer-approved draft and previewBinding to the app moderation queue. Requires confirmation PUBLISH_POST, placementConfirmation and fWarning. Shares approved content with the Tail community when moderation allows; this irreversible send never places a wager. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: create_tracked_slip
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: After the customer asks to save it, save one app ticket (the quote_grade ticket contract) to this account's saved slips through the app's POST tickets, with a stable client_mutation_id for retries. Stores the slip only; never prepares or places a wager.

ticket.description: The app ticket: clientSlipId, clientRevision, source, intent, bookId, currency, stakeMinor, confirmation, offeredReturnMinor, acceptedReturnMinor, settlementTerms and 1-25 selections (same as quote_grade ticket).

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: onboarding_preferences
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the current league catalog and per-league team membership, or read/save your leagues and teams. Use original source-qualified IDs. Logos are unavailable. Get the current revision before a confirmed set: merge imports device selections with account order first; replace saves Settings selections and allows clearing. Reuse a stable commandKey for retries. This changes preferences only.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: fade_post
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Preview actual supported opposite selections for a visible Tail post at the customer’s bookId and jurisdiction. Unavailable legs remain unavailable; this is not the mathematical complement of a parlay. After explicit customer review, confirm with the original preview binding, post revision, exact stake/currency/settlement fields and CONFIRM_COPY_TICKET. Keep commandKey stable on retries. Saves a private unplaced ticket and records the existing confirmed Fade activity; never places a wager. Use get_tail_post for the source’s current Fade count and permitted actors.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: view_tail_analysis
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Open the visible post’s original saved full Grade or Doctor analysis using the app’s existing paid research access. Requires Tail and saved-report read consent. A subscription_required response means the customer needs the approved upgrade flow; do not start research or substitute a private report. Picks stay visible through get_tail_post.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: grade_settings
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read or save this account’s Grade risk preference, analysis depth and unit size. Saving requires the exact confirmed settings, current revision and a stable command key. Risk preference is separate from computed report risk. No Grade or research starts.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_bettor_history
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read a visible bettor profile’s settled History in units.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: set_profile_links
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Preview then explicitly confirm your own profile links. Supply draft {profileId,target: profile,expectedRevision,links:[{platform,handle?,url?}]}. Array order is display order; omit a platform to remove it. Use [] for no links. One per platform: x, instagram, tiktok, youtube, discord, facebook. For Discord/Facebook provide url and optional display handle. Set needs the returned preview draft (including any resolved Discord name), exact previewBinding, SET_PROFILE_LINKS confirmation and a stable commandKey. verified is server-owned.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: list_sportsbooks
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read this account’s linked sportsbooks exactly as the app shows them: whether sportsbook linking is allowed, each account (accountId, book, region, betsSynced), its connection (verified, paused, reconnect_required, revoked, disabled, unknown), needsReconnect, its last check and last refresh, the newest bet import, handoffAvailability (the same per-book state decision as the app; false means odds only, unknown state allows handoffs), and booksOnTickets: the books on the customer’s saved tickets (bookAbbr, tickets, lastSeenAt). Never contacts the sportsbook.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: connect_sportsbook
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Return a 10-minute betslipdoctor.ai link (linkUrl, expiresAt) for the customer to open and finish connecting a sportsbook. The app checks the requested book and optional two-letter state; without a state it uses the account’s state when known, otherwise the sportsbook list opens. If the state list is unavailable, the sportsbook list may open instead. While linking is not allowed it answers book_link_required with consent.text, consent.privacyUrl and consent.textVersion: show the text and privacy link word for word, and only after the customer’s explicit yes call again with consent true, that consentTextVersion and a commandKey (a missing or stale version is refused). Never sees sportsbook passwords; never places a wager.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: refresh_sportsbook
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Check an owned linked sportsbook accountId for new bets, the same import the app runs: queues one history check for the account’s linked books (each allowed sportsbook is asked for its newest bets) and returns the check id and its state. Repeats within 30 seconds are refused with sync_cooldown; an unknown accountId is refused. Read progress with list_sportsbooks.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: disconnect_sportsbook
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Disconnect an owned linked sportsbook accountId, the same as the app’s Disconnect: BSD imports for it stop at once and the link to your sportsbook is removed in the background. Requires confirm true after the customer explicitly asks; without it nothing changes. Saved bets stay in History. Reconnecting needs connect_sportsbook again.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: search_markets
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Search the same way the app’s Home and Live search does. query is the typed text (a team, game, player or market name, e.g. "Bears" or "Rasmussen"); category is games (default), players or markets. Optional league (LGUE_ id) or sport (SPRT_ id) narrows it, limit is 1-20 and cursor is the previous result’s next. Games come back recently started first, then upcoming; each carries its eventId for get_box_score or the board; price_shop_slip takes a saved ticketId. Players carry playerId and team; markets carry selectionId, market, side and line. A player and a stat together (e.g. "Bijan Robinson receptions") answer his lines on that stat in his team's next game with DraftKings' current price (prices: selectionId, line, oddsAmerican). Other results are names and ids only.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_box_score
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read the in-play or final score and box score for one game (eventId from search_markets or the board), the same read as the app’s Live game page: status (in_progress, final or suspended), period and clock, each team’s score and period-by-period line, team statistics, and player statistic tables. state unavailable with a reason (e.g. unsupported_league, no_usable_body when the game has not started, source_stale) means the app shows no box score either. Covers the leagues the app’s Live game page covers, soccer included.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: list_linkable_sportsbooks
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: List the sportsbooks this account can link, the same list as the app’s Settings > Sportsbooks picker: each book (bookId, name, abbr) with the two-letter states it can be linked in. state (two letters, e.g. NJ) filters to the books linkable there; without it the account’s own linking state is used when its linked books share one. Use a listed book and state with connect_sportsbook. Never contacts a sportsbook.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: check_slip
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: The app slip’s rule for this conversation’s slip. Send legs (ids plus the oddsAmerican, line, observedAt and startsAt they were added with) or a ticketId from add_doctor_parlay_to_slip or copy_tail_slip. Legs whose game started or finished or whose line is gone come back in removed: drop them. legs stay, at current odds and line. empty: the slip is gone, build a new one. Run before Grade, before a book link, and when they return.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: get_plan
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read this account’s BetSlip Doctor plan exactly as the app shows it: the plan (free, starter, pro or elite), where it is paid (paymentSource), its status and current period end, the plan limits, and this period’s usage: Grades left and when they reset, Doctor chats left this month (and today on Free). Read only; changes nothing.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: add_funds
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Return a link to add funds to the pay-as-you-go balance. The customer signs in and confirms there; this tool never charges.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: start_plan_upgrade
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Return the betslipdoctor.ai link (linkUrl) where the customer upgrades or manages a card subscription. plan is the plan they want (starter, pro, elite, heavy_199, heavy_499, heavy_999, heavy_1999 or enterprise; default the next plan up), interval month or year (default month). Card subscribers at any tier get the account page link. The customer opens the link, signs in with this same account and makes changes there; this tool never charges, starts a payment or changes the plan.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: tail_social
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: The Tail actions the app has, on its own routes, for this account. For actions marked with a confirmation, an otherwise valid call without that body.confirmation returns a preview: show it and get the customer’s yes before sending the literal. Other actions, including repost, send on a valid call; use them only when the customer asks. reply: POST tail/posts/{postId}/replies {text} (confirmation PUBLISH_REPLY); remove_reply: POST tail/replies/{replyId}/remove (confirmation DELETE_REPLY); like: POST tail/posts/{postId}/like {active}; add on another account’s approved post; bookmark: POST tail/posts/{postId}/bookmark {active}; pin: POST tail/posts/{postId}/pin {active}; pin your own approved post; vote: POST tail/posts/{postId}/vote {choice: place|pass|null}; vote on another account’s asking post; repost: POST tail/posts/{postId}/repost {active}; quote: POST tail/posts/{postId}/quotes {expectedRevision, text} (confirmation PUBLISH_QUOTE); poll_vote: POST tail/posts/{postId}/poll-vote {option 0-3}; relation: POST tail/relations {profileId, kind follow|mute|block, active}; list_create: POST tail/lists {name, description?} (confirmation CREATE_LIST); list_edit: POST tail/lists/{listId} {expectedRevision, name, description}; list_member: POST tail/lists/{listId}/members {profileId, active}; list_remove: POST tail/lists/{listId}/remove (confirmation DELETE_LIST); report_post: POST tail/reports body {postId, reason, details?} (confirmation REPORT_POST); report_reply: POST tail/replies/{replyId}/report {reason, details?} (confirmation REPORT_REPLY); report_profile: POST tail/profiles/{profileId}/report {reason, details?} (confirmation REPORT_PROFILE); delete_post: POST tail/posts/{postId}/remove (confirmation DELETE_POST); profile_edit: POST tail/profile {expectedRevision, displayName, bio, settings: {visibility: public|hidden, rankVisibility: auto|on|off}}; claim_handle: POST account/handle {handle (3-20 a-z 0-9 _, trimmed and lowercased), displayName, bio?, settings: {visibility: public|hidden, rankVisibility: auto|on|off}} (confirmation CREATE_PROFILE); profile_photo: POST tail/profile/photo {expectedRevision, photo: {mime image/jpeg|image/png, base64} or null}; MCP request max 60,000 characters.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: notifications
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: This account's notification inbox and settings, the same as the app's bell. feed: GET notifications/feed params {filter all|mentions|verified, limit 1-25, cursor}; defaults all and 25; continue with next as cursor for the same account and filter; verified currently returns no items; item: GET notifications/items/{itemId} itemId is the notification UUID; read: POST notifications/read body {action read, ids} (1-25 unique UUIDs) or {action read_all}; settings: GET notifications/settings; set_settings: POST notifications/settings body {confirmation SET_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES, expectedRevision from settings, channels {grade, doctor, settle, rounds, linemove, tail, rank} as booleans, pushRoast boolean}. Confirm the requested change with the customer before a write. A valid write is sent without a separate MCP preview unless the action says otherwise.

commandKey.description: Writes: one stable key per write, reused on every retry.

body.description: The app request body for this action, unchanged.

params.description: The app query (filters, limit, cursor) for a read.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: doctor_actions
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: The Doctor actions beside the conversation, as the app does them. Record a decision only when the customer says what they did; change memory consent only when they ask. Delete and forget preview until confirmed; reuse the same commandKey on a retry. desk: GET desk optional params {placed: comma-separated pick ids}; the Doctor’s Desk: open picks with a real Grade of B or better (label, book, price, edge, paper stake in units, bet link, grade), the picks named in placed (open or settled) and the Desk’s record; Free and Starter get locked rows (league and start time only) and the record; desk_price: GET desk/price params {pickId}; the book’s price right now against the posted price: state same|better|worse|gone and whether it is still a pick. Pro and up; desk_report: GET desk/report params {pickId}; the Grade report behind a Desk pick’s letter (grade.report true). Pro and up; decision: GET doctor/messages/{messageId}/decision optional params {beforeRevision}; returns the saved reply reference and responseRevision; record_decision: POST doctor/messages/{messageId}/decision body {messageId, messageDigest, threadId, binding:{ticketId, reportId, history}, expectedRevision, confirmation: SAVE_RESPONSE, decision: followed|changed|skipped|unknown, modifiedTicketId?}; use the exact reference and responseRevision from decision; binding values can be null; subject to the app Doctor action access gate; saved_reply: GET doctor/messages/{messageId}/saved-reply params {messageDigest, threadId, ticketId?, reportId?, historyKind?, historyId?}; omit null bindings, include ticketId with reportId, and send historyKind and historyId together; grade_this: POST doctor/messages/{messageId}/grade-quote app body; compare_books: POST doctor/messages/{messageId}/book-prices app body; revise_ticket: POST doctor/messages/{messageId}/revisions app body; book_check: GET doctor/book-comparisons/{comparisonId}; delete_thread: POST doctor/threads/{threadId}/delete (confirmation DELETE); memory_status: GET doctor/memory; memory_context: GET doctor/memory/context; memory_consent: POST doctor/memory/consent body {enabled, expectedGeneration, confirmation}; use memory_status.generation and ALLOW_HONCHO_MEMORY when enabling or DISABLE_HONCHO_MEMORY when disabling; enabling requires notes memory enabled; memory_forget_all: POST doctor/memory/forget body {expectedGeneration}; use memory_status.generation; confirmed notes remain and vendor erasure can be pending (confirmation FORGET_RECALLED_MEMORY); notes_consent: POST memory/consent body {enabled, expectedGeneration}; use memory_status.generation; the switch controls both notes and automatic Doctor memory, without deleting notes. Confirm the requested change with the customer before a write. A valid write is sent without a separate MCP preview unless the action says otherwise.

commandKey.description: Writes: one stable key per write, reused on every retry.

body.description: The app request body for this action, unchanged.

ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.name: account_settings
ai.betslipdoctor/mcp.description: Read and change this account through its signed-in product routes. Change AI and model-training privacy settings in the app. Sportsbook actions follow the app's plan permissions. Bug-report actions use server reports, separate from reports held only on a device; those routes must be enabled. preferences: GET account; set_preferences: POST account/preferences {roastLevel?, morningRounds?, unitMinor?, bankrollMinor?, oddsFormat?, gradeDepthDefault?}; use set_timezone for timezone; favorite_teams: GET account/favorite-teams Saved priority team IDs, separate from Settings sports preferences; set_favorite_teams: POST account/favorite-teams {favoriteTeamIds: string[]}; replaces the saved priority list; sports_preferences: GET account/onboarding-preferences Settings leagues and teams; set_sports_preferences: POST account/onboarding-preferences {selections, mode, expectedRevision, confirmed: true}; read current selections and revision first; merge keeps existing selections, replace replaces the entire list; send only after the owner confirms; use onboarding_preferences catalog and teams for current source IDs; set_timezone: POST account/timezone {timezone}; quota: GET account/quota; research_balance: GET units/balance Research units balance and usage; book_balances: GET sportsbooks/balances; set_book_currency: POST sportsbooks/currency {accountId, identityDigest, expectedRevision, currency: supported uppercase three-letter code with two decimal places | null, confirmation: ACCOUNT_CURRENCY}; send only after the owner confirms; seen_books: GET sportsbooks/seen; bug_report: POST bug-reports {area, whatHappened, whatExpected?, app?}; bug_reports: GET bug-reports; bug_rewards: GET bug-reports/rewards. Confirm the requested change with the customer before a write. A valid write is sent without a separate MCP preview unless the action says otherwise.

commandKey.description: Writes: one stable key per write, reused on every retry.

body.description: The app request body for this action, unchanged.
